articles.title: Concise-9B: Removing the Slack from a Reasoning Model's Thinking
articles.abstract: Reasoning models answer better when they think longer, but a thinking trace keeps going well after its answer has formed. We measure this slack in Qwen3.5-9B and remove most of it with concise self-training: two rounds of on-policy rejection-sampling fine-tuning that keep the shortest correct samples, plus a small share of answer-synthesis targets, giving Concise-9B. On 8,983 held-out problems (competition and hard mathematics, SuperGPQA, a five-area confirmation set and MMLU-Pro), Concise-9B generates 0.66x the tokens of Qwen3.5-9B at a 32K thinking budget, with accuracy equivalent within +/-1 point (-0.20 [-0.77, +0.36] points). Forcing each trace on the hard and confirmation sets to answer every 2,048 thinking tokens, we find that 54-64% of Qwen3.5-9B's thinking tokens come after the point from which every forced answer equals the final one (41-48% for Concise-9B). Stopping there would keep every answer at 0.35-0.44x the base model's tokens, but finding that point takes hindsight: stopping when three consecutive forced answers agree costs the base model 2.4-9.2 points. Concise self-training removes slack without that cost: 86% [83, 90] of the thinking tokens it saves come after the answer has formed. It has a limit: with traces continued to 80K tokens, Concise-9B solves 25 fewer of 1,276 hard problems (-25 [-49, -1]), mostly in competition mathematics. The measurement also yields a cheap commit signal for adaptive sampling that matched two-sample escalation within +/-1 point at 0.67x its tokens in a pre-registered test. Results on Qwen3.5-4B, on which the recipe was developed, and a replication on Olmo-3-7B-Think suggest that the saving depends on how verbose the base model is.
articles.titleCn: Concise-9B：消除推理模型思考中的冗余
articles.abstractCn: 推理模型在思考时间更长时回答效果更好，但思考轨迹在答案形成后仍会继续进行。我们在Qwen3.5-9B中测量了这种冗余，并通过简洁自训练将其大部分去除：两轮基于策略的拒绝采样微调，保留最短的正确样本，加上少量答案合成目标，得到简洁版Concise-9B。在8,983个保留问题（竞赛和高等数学、SuperGPQA、五领域确认集和MMLU-Pro）上，Concise-9B在32K思考预算下生成的token数量为Qwen3.5-9B的0.66倍，准确率在±1分范围内相当（-0.20 [-0.77, +0.36]分）。强制硬问题和确认集上的每个轨迹每2,048个思考token回答一次，我们发现Qwen3.5-9B的54-64%的思考token出现在每个强制答案等于最终答案的点之后（Concise-9B为41-48%）。在此处停止会使每个答案的token数量为基准模型的0.35-0.44倍，但找到这个点需要后见之明：当三个连续的强制答案一致时停止，基准模型会损失2.4-9.2分。简洁自训练去除了冗余而不产生这种成本：它节省的86% [83, 90]的思考token出现在答案形成之后。它有一个极限：当轨迹延长至80K token时，Concise-9B在1,276个硬问题中少了25个（-25 [-49, -1]），主要集中在竞赛数学。测量结果还为自适应采样提供了一个廉价的提交信号，在预先注册的测试中，它在0.67倍的token数量下与两样本升级在±1分范围内匹配。在Qwen3.5-4B上（该配方在此模型上开发）和Olmo-3-7B-Think上的复现结果表明，这种节省取决于基准模型的冗长程度。

articles.title: When the Text Is Silent: Memory Shortcuts and the Validity of LLM Annotation under Evidence Insufficiency
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to annotate text for social science research, content moderation, and training data. Their broad knowledge of real-world entities raises a concern: when labeling a text, do they rely on its evidence or substitute what they already know? We call this behavior a memory shortcut and examine when it emerges, what amplifies it, and how to mitigate it. Using 995 widely recognized public figures and four matched control names per figure, we construct counterfactual texts that separate textual evidence from prior knowledge, and evaluate three commercial LLMs on 121,594 prompts each across five stages. We find a striking asymmetry. Although all models recognize nearly every figure, none follows memory over the text when the two conflict. Shortcuts instead emerge when evidence is absent: for one model, famous names raise the rate of remembered occupations, ages, and countries by 17.0, 14.9, and 6.8 percentage points relative to synthetic names. These effects occur only for recognized figures, and 98.6% of the resulting labels are factually correct about the namesake while none is supported by the text. Evaluation threats and answer-contingent rewards amplify shortcuts by 8.7 and 12.4 points. Famous names also raise leadership ratings of sparsely documented applicants by 0.22 and 0.28 points in two models. A namesake reminder and name masking each eliminate the shortcuts, with trade-offs in gender annotation. LLM annotations can thus be factually correct yet methodologically invalid. Trustworthy LLM annotation requires audits that test evidence absence, account for incentives in annotation instructions, and evaluate the attribute-specific trade-offs of mitigation.
articles.titleCn: 当文本沉默时：记忆捷径与证据不足下LLM标注的有效性
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用于社会科学研究、内容审核和训练数据的文本标注。它们对现实世界实体的广泛知识引发了一个担忧：在标注文本时，它们是依赖文本证据，还是替换它们已有的知识？我们将这种行为称为记忆捷径，并考察它何时出现、什么会放大它以及如何缓解它。我们使用995个被广泛认可的公众人物及其匹配的四个控制名称，构建了分离文本证据和先验知识的反事实文本，并在五个阶段对每个模型在121,594个提示上进行了评估。我们发现了一个惊人的不对称性。尽管所有模型都几乎识别了每一个人物，但当两者冲突时，没有模型会优先考虑记忆而非文本。捷径反而在证据缺失时出现：对于其中一个模型，与合成名称相比，著名名称使记住的职业、年龄和国家的比例分别提高了17.0、14.9和6.8个百分点。这些效应仅发生在被识别的人物身上，而98.6%的最终标签在人物原型上是事实正确的，但没有一个得到文本支持。评估威胁和答案相关的奖励会使捷径分别放大8.7和12.4个百分点。在两个模型中，著名名称还会使记录不完整申请人的领导评分分别提高0.22和0.28个百分点。一个人物原型提醒和名称屏蔽分别消除了捷径，但在性别标注上存在权衡。因此，LLM的标注可能事实正确但方法上无效。可信赖的LLM标注需要审计，以测试证据缺失、在标注说明中考虑激励，并评估缓解措施的属性特定权衡。

articles.title: Current state of LLMs for Arabic dialectal machine translation
articles.abstract: This work presents an evaluation of large language models (LLMs) for English to dialectal Arabic machine translation on the MADAR dataset. We evaluate both translation directions (English to Arabic and vice-versa) on 16 Arabic dialects. Our experiments cover a diverse set of models, including specialized Arabic models (Jais, Nile), multilingual models (Gemma, Command-R, Mistral, Aya), and commercial APIs (GPT-4.1). We employ multiple evaluation metrics: BLEU, CHRF, COMET (both reference-based and reference-less variants) and GEMBA (LLM-as-a-judge), as well as a small-scale manual evaluation, to assess translation quality. We discuss the challenges of automatic MT evaluation, especially in the context of Arabic dialects. We also evaluate the ability of LLMs to classify the dialect used in a text. The study offers insights into the capabilities and limitations of current LLMs for dialectal Arabic machine translation, particularly highlighting the difficulty of handling dialectal diversity, although the results may be influenced by possible training data contamination, which is always a concern with LLMs.
articles.titleCn: 当前阿拉伯方言机器翻译中大型语言模型的状态
articles.abstractCn: 本研究对大型语言模型（LLMs）在MADAR数据集上进行英语到方言阿拉伯语机器翻译的性能进行了评估。我们在16种阿拉伯方言上评估了两个翻译方向（英语到阿拉伯语和反向）。我们的实验涵盖了多种模型，包括专门的阿拉伯语模型（Jais、Nile）、多语言模型（Gemma、Command-R、Mistral、Aya）以及商业API（GPT-4.1）。我们采用了多种评估指标：BLEU、CHRF、COMET（包括基于参考和非基于参考的变体）以及GEMBA（将LLM作为评判者），并进行了小规模的人工评估，以评估翻译质量。我们讨论了自动机器翻译评估的挑战，特别是在阿拉伯方言背景下的情况。我们还评估了LLMs识别文本中所用方言的能力。该研究揭示了当前LLMs在方言阿拉伯语机器翻译方面的能力和局限性，特别指出了处理方言多样性的困难，尽管结果可能受到训练数据污染的影响，而这是LLMs始终存在的一个问题。

articles.title: Hinted Scaling Laws
articles.abstract: Scaling laws predict the outcome of large, expensive training runs by extrapolating trends from smaller, cheaper runs. On downstream accuracy evaluations, these predictions fail when the weaker models produced by the cheaper runs score near zero accuracy, because these scores give no trend to extrapolate to larger scales. We introduce hinted scaling laws, which use privileged information to turn a benchmark into a continuum of easier versions so that even the small models score above zero. We find that accuracy rises smoothly and predictably with the hint level, enabling new types of scaling laws that operate below the noise threshold. On the Delphi pretraining ladder, a hinted scaling law fit on models trained with at most $10^{20}$ FLOPs forecasts the GSM8K accuracy of a $10^{23}$ FLOP model (25.9%) to within 3 percentage points; a standard scaling law under-forecasts it by 13 percentage points when fit on the same models and by 12 even with models up to $10^{22}$ FLOPs in the fit. Across both this pretraining ladder and a collection of post-trained model families, hinted scaling laws reduce the median forecasting error on GSM8K, AIME and HLE from 21 percentage points to 4.3. Hinting also reduces the number of test examples needed to tell whether one model is better than another by widening the accuracy gaps between models while approximately preserving their order: a single hinted rollout per problem ranks nearly indistinguishable models as accurately as five unhinted rollouts. Our results suggest that hinting is a general primitive for improving the accuracy and cost of downstream scaling laws and other prediction tasks in model development.
articles.titleCn: 暗示的缩放定律
articles.abstractCn: 规模法则通过从小规模、低成本训练运行中推断趋势来预测大规模、昂贵训练运行的结果。在下游准确度评估中，这些预测在较便宜运行产生的较弱模型得分接近零时失效，因为这些得分无法提供用于推断更大规模的趋势。我们引入了提示规模法则，该法则利用特权信息将基准转化为一系列更容易的版本，使得小型模型也能得分高于零。我们发现准确度随着提示水平的提升而平滑且可预测地增长，从而催生了新的、在噪声阈值以下的规模法则类型。在德尔菲预训练阶梯上，基于最多 $10^{20}$ FLOPs 训练的模型拟合的提示规模法则，能够将 $10^{23}$ FLOPs 模型的 GSM8K 准确度（25.9%）预测误差控制在3个百分点以内；而标准规模法则在拟合相同模型时，预测误差高达13个百分点，即使拟合的模型规模高达 $10^{22}$ FLOPs，误差也达12个百分点。在这预训练阶梯以及一系列后训练模型家族中，提示规模法则将 GSM8K、AIME 和 HLE 的中位数预测误差从21个百分点降至4.3个百分点。提示还能通过扩大模型间的准确度差距（同时近似保持其顺序）来减少判断一个模型是否优于另一个所需的测试样本数量：每个问题仅进行一次提示扩展，就能几乎与五次无提示扩展一样准确地排序几乎无法区分的模型。我们的结果表明，提示是一种通用的基础方法，可用于提高模型开发中下游规模法则及其他预测任务的准确度和成本。

articles.title: Metamorphic Testing for Evaluating Robustness of Sentiment Analysis Models
articles.abstract: Machine learning systems are challenging to test using traditional software testing methods because their behavior is learned from data rather than explicitly programmed. This challenge is particularly significant in natural language processing (NLP), where small input variations can lead to unexpected model behavior. Conventional evaluation metrics, such as accuracy and F1-score, often fail to capture such inconsistencies. Metamorphic testing addresses this limitation by evaluating expected relationships between original and transformed inputs. With the increasing prevalence of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) and language-based AI systems, the need for systematic robustness testing has become even more pronounced. Motivated by this growing need, this paper presents a lightweight, batch-based metamorphic testing approach for evaluating the robustness of such systems. In particular, we consider sentiment analysis as a representative NLP task and evaluate a pretrained classifier under four transformations: synonym replacement, typo injection, word-order variation, and negation. Using consistency score, flip accuracy, and confidence change, we identify strengths in handling semantic variations and vulnerabilities to textual noise and logical transformations. These findings highlight the value of metamorphic testing in identifying behavioral inconsistencies beyond conventional performance metrics and demonstrate its potential as a systematic framework for evaluating the robustness of language-based AI systems and guiding performance improvements before deployment.
articles.titleCn: 基于元测试评估情感分析模型的鲁棒性
articles.abstractCn: 使用传统软件测试方法对机器学习系统进行测试具有挑战性，因为它们的行为是通过数据学习而非显式编程获得的。这一挑战在自然语言处理（NLP）中尤为显著，因为微小的输入变化可能导致模型行为出现意外。传统的评估指标，如准确率和F1分数，往往无法捕捉这种不一致性。变形测试通过评估原始输入和转换输入之间的预期关系来解决这一局限性。随着生成式人工智能（GenAI）和基于语言的AI系统的日益普及，对系统鲁棒性进行系统性测试的需求变得更加迫切。受这一日益增长的需求的驱动，本文提出了一种轻量级、基于批次的变形测试方法，用于评估此类系统的鲁棒性。具体而言，我们以情感分析作为一个代表性的NLP任务，在四种转换下评估一个预训练的分类器：同义词替换、拼写错误注入、词序变化和否定。通过一致性分数、翻转准确率和置信度变化，我们识别了系统处理语义变化的优势以及其对文本噪声和逻辑转换的脆弱性。这些发现突出了变形测试在识别传统性能指标之外的行為不一致性方面的价值，并展示了其作为系统性框架评估基于语言的AI系统鲁棒性以及指导部署前性能改进的潜力。

articles.title: Can AI Reviewers See Your Efforts to Improve Your Paper? A Large-Scale Study of Paper Revision Trajectories
articles.abstract: AI reviewers are increasingly used to assess scientific manuscripts, yet it remains unclear whether their judgments reflect the improvements authors make through revision. We investigate this question using PaperTrajectory-2026, the 2026 release of PaperTrajectory, a dataset of 6,959 paper trajectories across five AI conferences, with automatic annotations of changes along 14 dimensions and separate judgments of overall quality. The annotations show that major improvements emphasize empirical evidence and framing, while later revisions tend toward incremental improvement. Using independent assessments of manuscript versions from eight AI reviewers, we examine whether annotated major improvements receive higher scores, which revision dimensions are associated with score changes, and whether user opinions can outweigh observed revision gains. Every reviewer leaves scores unchanged on most major improvements, and agreement on the direction of score changes is weak. Revision dimensions show some reviewer-specific associations with score increases, but provide limited predictive discrimination and no consistent guide across reviewers. Even when a revision earns a higher neutral score, a brief negative user opinion can erase or reverse that advantage, with substantial variation across reviewers. These findings show that substantive revisions are not consistently reflected in review scores and that observed scoring gains can be vulnerable to user framing, motivating assessments that connect manuscript evidence to overall judgments and remain stable when no scientific evidence changes.
articles.titleCn: 人工智能审稿人能看到你为改进论文所做的努力吗？一项关于论文修改轨迹的大规模研究
articles.abstractCn: AI审稿人越来越多地被用于评估科学论文，但尚不清楚他们的评判是否反映了作者通过修改所做出的改进。我们使用PaperTrajectory-2026来研究这个问题，这是PaperTrajectory的2026年版本，一个包含5个AI会议中6,959篇论文轨迹的数据集，具有14个维度的自动变更标注和独立的整体质量评判。标注显示，主要改进侧重于实证证据和框架，而后期修订则倾向于渐进式改进。我们使用8位AI审稿人独立评估的论文版本，检验标注的主要改进是否获得更高分数，哪些修订维度与分数变化相关，以及用户意见是否可以超越观察到的修订收益。每位审稿人大多对主要改进的分数保持不变，且对分数变化方向的共识较弱。修订维度显示出某些与审稿人特定的分数增加相关联，但预测区分度有限，且在审稿人之间没有一致的指导。即使修订获得了更高的中性分数，简短负面用户意见也可能抹去或逆转这种优势，且在审稿人之间存在显著差异。这些发现表明，实质性修订并不总是反映在审稿分数中，且观察到的评分收益可能易受用户框架影响，因此需要评估将论文证据与整体判断联系起来，并在没有科学证据变化时保持稳定。

articles.title: Who Should Score the Cache? Mid-Depth Layers Are the Best Judges of KV-Cache Eviction
articles.abstract: Key-value (KV) cache eviction methods rank tokens by attention scores, and each layer scores its own cache. To our knowledge, no eviction method asks which layer should score. We find, across twenty-one models, that the depth of the scoring layer governs eviction quality. On the eighteen models with per-layer caches, spanning 0.5B to 109B, long-context retrieval accuracy collapses at shallow layers, peaks between 0.4 and 0.75 of depth, and degrades at the last layer. The curve arises because a layer judges tokens well only once it has used the question to find the answer, which takes several layers. Modeling eviction as a top-$k$ cut, we compute answer survival probability from prefill attention and reproduce the measured curves. This approach selects the scoring layer using calibration prompts with known answers, and the selected layer is the best layer measured on most models and never significantly below it. It improves on the own-layer default on sixteen of the eighteen models, with significant gains on seven, all at 14B or below, while on larger models the default is already close to the best mid-depth layer. Scoring every cache from the selected layer while keeping one set of tokens for all heads also beats per-head SnapKV by 18 to 43 points on five models up to 14B under tight budgets. This gain carries over to financial filings at 32K context, all at the same memory budget, with no extra forward pass. The same curve explains a penalty in shared-cache models, where several layers read one cache and the layer that writes it scores by default. On Gemma-4-E2B the writer is shallow and loses 28 points to a mid-depth reader at a 10% budget. We also find that in open-book question answering (LongBench) no mid-depth layer beats the own-layer default.
articles.titleCn: 谁应该评分缓存？中等深度层是 KV 缓存驱逐的最佳评判者
articles.abstractCn: 键值（KV）缓存驱逐方法通过注意力分数对标记进行排序，并且每一层对其自身的缓存进行评分。据我们所知，没有驱逐方法会询问哪一层应该评分。我们发现，在21个模型中，评分层的深度决定了驱逐质量。在18个具有每层缓存的模型中，范围从0.5B到109B，长上下文检索准确率在浅层崩溃，在深度的0.4到0.75之间达到峰值，并在最后一层下降。这条曲线的出现是因为只有当一层使用问题找到答案后，它才能很好地判断标记，而这一过程需要经过多层。我们将驱逐建模为顶-k切割，通过预填充注意力计算答案存活概率，并重现了测量的曲线。这种方法使用具有已知答案的校准提示来选择评分层，并且所选层在大多数模型上都是测量最好的层，并且从未显著低于它。它在18个模型中的16个模型上优于本层默认值，在7个模型上取得了显著提升，所有这些模型都在14B或以下，而在更大的模型上，默认值已经接近最佳的中间层。在紧张的预算下，从所选层对每个缓存进行评分，同时为所有头保留一组标记，也在5个模型上（最高14B）比每头SnapKV高出18到43分。这种提升也适用于32K上下文中的财务报告，在相同的内存预算下，无需额外的前向传递。相同的曲线解释了共享缓存模型中的惩罚，其中多层读取一个缓存，而写入它的层默认评分。在Gemma-4-E2B上，写入层较浅，在10%的预算下，它比一个中间层的读取层损失了28分。我们还发现，在开放式问答（LongBench）中，没有中间层能优于本层默认值。

articles.title: Test-Time Scaling for Open-Ended Reasoning at Small Model Scale
articles.abstract: A vote over a model's samples can only help when the samples disagree. For open-ended generation the binding question is therefore not how to combine samples but whether a model produces samples worth combining, a question test-time scaling has answered for math but not for free-form text. We study it at small scale with semantic cluster voting, a judge-free aggregator that groups a small instruct model's samples by meaning and returns the largest cluster's representative, with no reward model or self-judging. On a 250-prompt benchmark with three tiers of answer checkability, the same pattern holds across three model families (Qwen2.5-3B, Llama-3.2-3B, Gemma-2-2B) and two generation seeds: voting raises accuracy on the math control, where samples vary but stay checkable (a gain of +10 to +29 points across the three models), yet adds at most +0.30 judge points on open-ended text. On a larger 200-problem MATH-500 run with the primary model, the math gain is +8.5 points (95% CI [+4.0, +13.0]). Almost every open-ended sample falls into one meaning cluster, so there is little to select over. The collapse is consistent with instruction-tuning rather than model size, and raising decoding temperature does not recover usable diversity, because it costs more quality than it adds (net -0.64 judge points, 95% CI [-0.93, -0.37]).
articles.titleCn: 小模型规模下开放式推理的测试时缩放
articles.abstractCn: 对一个模型样本进行投票只有在样本存在分歧时才能发挥作用。因此，对于开放式生成而言，关键问题不在于如何组合样本，而在于模型是否生成了值得组合的样本，而时序扩展（test-time scaling）已经为数学问题解答提供了答案，但对自由文本而言尚未解决。我们通过语义聚类投票（semantic cluster voting）在小规模上研究这一问题，这是一种无需裁判的聚合方法，通过语义将小型指令模型的样本分组，并返回最大聚类的代表，不涉及奖励模型或自我评判。在一个包含三个答案可验证等级的250条提示基准测试中，这一模式在三个模型系列（Qwen2.5-3B、Llama-3.2-3B、Gemma-2-2B）和两个生成种子中都成立：投票提高了数学控制问题的准确率，其中样本存在差异但仍然可验证（三个模型分别提升了+10至+29个百分点），但在开放式文本上最多增加了+0.30个裁判分。在一个包含200个问题的MATH-500主要模型运行中，数学问题提升为+8.5个百分点（95%置信区间为[+4.0, +13.0]）。几乎每个开放式样本都落入一个语义聚类，因此几乎没有选择余地。这种收敛现象与指令微调（instruction-tuning）而非模型规模有关，提高解码温度并不能恢复可用多样性，因为它损失的质量多于它带来的增益（净损失-0.64个裁判分，95%置信区间为[-0.93, -0.37]）。

articles.title: Decision Models as Policy Gates for Coding Agents: Explicit Policy Boundaries Improve Detection and Reduce False Alarms
articles.abstract: Coding agents can destroy data, leak secrets and message the wrong person faster than a human can review. Could a decision model catch these risks at runtime? We evaluated 22 hosted decision models and two prompted general models as classifiers for a multi-rule policy engine. A synthetic dataset of 2,643 tool calls was labeled blind against 28 rules, with a sealed holdout. With a single shared preamble in both conditions, explicit boundaries written as examples and counterexamples raised recall by 5.5-26.1 percentage points on all 23 available models and reduced false positives on 21. Jev 1.14's recall rose from 89.3% to 98.2%, while unnecessary interruptions fell from 30.6% to 4.8% of 252 clean actions. With examples, its median latency was 120 ms at $0.46 per thousand requests. Strong models retained the recall gains when concrete names were replaced by generic descriptions; three largely retained them when the same boundaries were written as prose. On 16 new scenarios written after the initial studies, a follow-up improved recall on 22 of 23 models and reduced unnecessary interruptions on 21. We release the dataset, rule texts and harness.
articles.comment: 15 pages, 2 figures. Dataset, rule texts and harness available at https://github.com/agentapprove/decision-policy-rules
articles.titleCn: 决策模型作为编码代理的政策门：明确的政策边界可提升检测效果并减少误报
articles.abstractCn: 编程代理能够比人类审查更快地销毁数据、泄露机密和向错误的人发送消息。决策模型能否在运行时捕获这些风险？我们评估了22个托管的决策模型和两个提示的通用模型，将它们作为多规则策略引擎的分类器。一个包含2643个工具调用的合成数据集，在28条规则下进行了盲法标注，并有一个密封的保留集。在两种条件下共享单个前缀，明确界限作为示例和反例使所有23个可用模型的召回率提高了5.5-26.1个百分点，并在21个模型上减少了误报。Jev 1.14的召回率从89.3%提高到98.2%，不必要的干扰从252个干净操作的30.6%降至4.8%。使用示例时，其中位数延迟为120毫秒，每千次请求成本为0.46美元。强模型在具体名称被通用描述替代时仍保持了召回率提升；三个模型在相同界限以散文形式编写时基本保持了提升。在初始研究后编写的16个新场景中，后续测试使23个模型中的22个召回率提高，并在21个模型上减少了不必要的干扰。我们发布了数据集、规则文本和测试工具。

articles.title: Multi-Agent Collusion and the J-Space
articles.abstract: LLM agents are increasingly deployed in Multi-Agent Systems (MAS), and they introduce the risk of coordination among agents that might escape human oversight. The J-space has been used to uncover deception in single LLMs, but its use for uncovering and steering collusion between agents remains unexplored. We show, with interpretability experiments on DeepSeek-V4-Flash (284B) on the NARCBench collusion benchmark, that colluding agents' J-space holds the collusion itself: before replying, 86% of colluders represent misrepresentation, concealment or remorse. In a steganographic card-counting task, the receiver's J-space holds a hidden count, and causal interventions alter its count. We also introduce the Jacobian Pair Contrast (J-PACT), an unsupervised method for detecting collusion between agents. We evaluate J-PACT on four open-weight models: GPT-OSS-20B, Llama-3.3-70B-IT, Qwen3-32B, and DeepSeek-V4-Flash (284B). J-PACT retains 85% of the above-chance AUROC of supervised NARCBench probes, matches them on steganographic scenarios, and names the colluding pair up to its complement in 99% of detected runs.
articles.titleCn: 多智能体串通与J空间
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型代理（LLM agents）正越来越多地部署在多代理系统（MAS）中，它们引入了代理之间可能逃避人类监管的协调风险。J空间已被用于揭示单个LLM的欺骗行为，但其用于揭示和引导代理间串通的应用尚未探索。我们在NARCBench串通基准测试中，对DeepSeek-V4-Flash（284B）进行可解释性实验，表明串通代理的J空间本身就包含串通行为：在回复之前，86%的串通者表现出歪曲事实、隐瞒或悔恨。在一个隐写术计数任务中，接收者的J空间包含一个隐藏计数，因果干预会改变其计数。我们还引入了雅可比对对比（J-PACT），这是一种用于检测代理间串通的无监督方法。我们在四个开放权重模型上评估了J-PACT：GPT-OSS-20B、Llama-3.3-70B-IT、Qwen3-32B和DeepSeek-V4-Flash（284B）。J-PACT保留了上述监督NARCBench探针85%的超过随机AUROC，在隐写术场景中表现相同，并在99%的检测运行中识别出串通对直至其补集。

articles.title: Detailed Derivation of The Backpropagation Algorithm
articles.abstract: Backpropagation is the standard method for computing the gradients that train neural networks, but it is usually presented in a compact vector form that skips the intermediate steps. This tutorial derives backpropagation step by step for a fully connected feedforward network with sigmoid activations and a squared-error loss. Using a running example with three layers, we first differentiate the error with respect to a single weight by following its path through the network with the chain rule. We then show how summing over all paths leads to the error terms $δ$ and to the four general backpropagation equations in matrix form. Every term is annotated with its dimensions, so each equation can be checked for consistency. The derivation is then extended to $m$ training examples, where the weight gradients become a single matrix product and the bias term corresponds to broadcasting. It is also extended to mini-batch gradient descent, including why the gradient of a mini-batch estimates the full gradient. Batch and mini-batch training are both given as algorithms. Finally, each equation is linked to the corresponding line of a NumPy implementation trained on the AHDBase dataset of handwritten Arabic digits, and the complete code is included.
articles.titleCn: 反向传播算法的详细推导过程
articles.abstractCn: 反向传播是训练神经网络计算梯度的标准方法，但通常以紧凑的向量形式呈现，省略了中间步骤。本教程逐步推导具有Sigmoid激活函数和平方误差损失的完全连接前馈网络的反向传播。通过一个三层运行示例，我们首先使用链式法则沿着网络路径对误差相对于单个权重的导数进行求解。然后展示如何对所有路径求和，得到误差项δ以及矩阵形式的四个通用反向传播方程。每个项都标注了其维度，以便检查每个方程的一致性。接着将推导扩展到m个训练样本，此时权重梯度变为单个矩阵乘积，偏置项对应于广播操作。还扩展到小批量梯度下降，包括为什么小批量的梯度估计了完整梯度。批量训练和小批量训练都提供了算法。最后，每个方程都与AHDBase数据集中手写阿拉伯数字的NumPy实现中对应的代码行相链接，并提供了完整代码。

articles.title: GatedV: Self-Gated Values for Transformer Language Models
articles.abstract: Standard attention forms query (Q), key (K), and value (V) matrices through learned linear projections of input hidden states. Architectures such as GAU and Mega incorporate nonlinear transformations into attention. In this paper, we propose GatedV, a simple attention variant that applies SiLU only to V before aggregation without introducing additional trainable parameters. We evaluate GatedV against a standard decoder-only Transformer using matched parameter counts, paired initializations, and equal training-token budgets. At 2.33M parameters, GatedV reduces mean held-out perplexity from 59.1 to 57.9 (2.0%), with improvements across all five paired seeds. At 26.16M parameters, following an equal-budget learning-rate search, mean held-out perplexity falls from 20.2 to 19.7 (2.4%), with improvements across all three paired seeds. Small-model ablations show that the tested affine rescaling of values does not fully reproduce GatedV's gains. A short interleaved benchmark on NVIDIA DGX Spark measures approximately 0.7% higher full-context forward latency for the larger model, based on synchronized wall-clock timings. These findings suggest that value-only self-gating can improve language modeling performance without increasing parameter count or redesigning the attention-weighting mechanism.
articles.comment: 12 pages, 3 figures, Code and experimental results: https://github.com/yuliming1996/GatedV
articles.titleCn: GatedV：Transformer语言模型的自我门控值
articles.abstractCn: 标准注意力机制通过输入隐藏状态的线性投影形成查询（Q）、键（K）和值（V）矩阵。GAU和Mega等架构将非线性变换融入注意力机制。在本文中，我们提出了GatedV，一种简单的注意力变体，它仅对聚合前的V应用SiLU，而不引入额外的可训练参数。我们使用匹配参数数量、成对初始化和相等的训练标记预算，评估了GatedV与标准解码器-only Transformer的性能。在2.33M参数下，GatedV将平均保留困惑度从59.1降至57.9（2.0%），在所有五个成对种子上均有提升。在26.16M参数下，经过相等的预算学习率搜索后，平均保留困惑度从20.2降至19.7（2.4%），在所有三个成对种子上均有提升。小模型消融实验表明，所测试的值域仿射缩放并未完全重现GatedV的增益。在NVIDIA DGX Spark上的短交错基准测试显示，较大模型的完整上下文前向延迟基于同步的墙上时钟时间测量，大约高0.7%。这些结果表明，仅对值进行自门控可以提升语言建模性能，而无需增加参数数量或重新设计注意力加权机制。

articles.title: HaloGuard 2.0: An Open-Weights Constitutional Output Guard for Multilingual Response Safety
articles.abstract: An input guard decides whether a request reaches the model, but never sees what the model says. Harm that emerges during generation, because a jailbreak passed the input layer or a benign request drifted into operational detail, is visible only on the output side and only as tokens arrive. We present HaloGuard 2.0, an open-weight streaming output guard that assigns a safe/unsafe probability to every response token in a single forward pass, so a deployment can stop the stream once harm is confirmed. The guard reuses the constitution of HaloGuard 1.0, our input guard, to organise a 478,532-response training corpus, and supervises each token from the point where the response becomes harmful. We find that a guard trained on conventionally shaped data learns a shortcut specific to streaming: it judges the prompt instead of the response, and handles only 13.9% of matched safe/unsafe response pairs correctly. We correct this with a second phase on 106,043 counterfactual responses built around the base guard's own failure modes, and release the equal-weight average of the base and corrective models. On six English response-safety benchmarks, HaloGuard 2.0-0.8B reaches a macro F1 of 83.6 (83.3 on held-out halves of the decision-rule search), up from 72.8, with 38% fewer false positives. It matches the strongest full-response guards with 5-10x fewer parameters and is 2.6 points above the strongest streaming guard, Qwen3Guard-Stream-4B. A multilingual variant, HaloGuard 2.0-Poly-0.8B, trained on PolyGuardMix, reaches 83.1 F1 on the response labels of PolyGuardPrompts across 17 languages, 5.0 points above the strongest baseline. On one H100 the guard costs 0.37 ms per token per stream when moderating 64 concurrent responses. Both guards are hardened continuously through the weekly red-teaming protocol of HaloGuard 1.0, extended here to the output layer.
articles.titleCn: HaloGuard 2.0：一种开放权重宪法输出保护器，用于多语言响应安全
articles.abstractCn: 输入守卫决定请求是否到达模型，但从未看到模型说了什么。在生成过程中出现的危害，因为越狱通过了输入层或良性请求滑入操作细节，只能在输出端可见，并且仅在标记到达时可见。我们提出了 HaloGuard 2.0，一个开放权重的流式输出守卫，它在单次前向传递中对每个响应标记分配安全/不安全概率，以便部署可以在确认危害后停止流。该守卫重用了 HaloGuard 1.0（我们的输入守卫）的宪法，以组织一个 478,532 响应的训练语料库，并在响应变得有害时监督每个标记。我们发现，在传统形状数据上训练的守卫学习了一种针对流媒体的捷径：它判断提示而不是响应，并且仅正确处理 13.9% 的匹配安全/不安全响应对。我们通过在围绕基础守卫自身失效模式构建的 106,043 个反事实响应上的第二阶段进行纠正，并发布了基础模型和纠正模型的等权重平均值。在六个英语响应安全基准上，HaloGuard 2.0-0.8B 达到宏观 F1 83.6（在决策规则搜索的保留一半上为 83.3），从 72.8 提升至 38% 的假阳性更少。它以 5-10 倍更少的参数匹配了最强的全响应守卫，并且比最强的流式守卫 Qwen3Guard-Stream-4B 高 2.6 分。多语言变体 HaloGuard 2.0-Poly-0.8B，在 PolyGuardMix 上训练，在 17 种语言的 PolyGuardPrompts 响应标签上达到 83.1 的 F1，比最强的基线高 5.0 分。在一个 H100 上，当调节 64 个并发响应时，该守卫每流每标记成本 0.37 毫秒。两个守卫都通过 HaloGuard 1.0 的每周红队协议持续强化，此处扩展到输出层。

articles.title: FOLLIE: Automated Reasoning over the First Dataset of Sentences with their First-Order Logical Representation for French
articles.abstract: FOLLIE (for First-Order Logic for Language Inference and Entailment for French) connects French sentences, compositional first-order representations and automated natural language inference (NLI). The first French NLI-ready, NL-to-FOL resource, it contains 19,983 inference records and 36,987 non-empty sentence-slot--formula mappings from six heterogeneous NLI sources, retaining French lexical material and source problem structure. Its silver annotations are produced by a neural--symbolic pipeline, with 111 separately identified LLM-assisted additions. The construction combines morphosyntactic analysis, probability-conditioned categorial multitagging, grammatical proof search, discourse representation and first-order semantic construction. Stage-wise experiments show substantial gains in derivation coverage; analyses of conjunction distributions, logical-operator incidence and scope alternation characterise the resulting resource. We then develop an automatic inference engine whose input-conditioned background theories address lexical relations, quantification, quantities, event structure and temporal dependencies. Prover9 supplies proofs for entailment and contradiction, while Mace4 supports bounded consistency checks. Three-way accuracies are 65.37% on all 335 FraCaS-FR problems, 70.33% on 300 GQNLI-FR problems and 71.35% on 9,399 eligible SICK-FR records pooled across splits. Agreement with reference labels among committed decisions is 93.53%, 100.00% and 98.66%, at commitment coverage of 41.49%, 37.00% and 15.05%, respectively. Worked constructions, axiom schemas and proof analyses explain these outcomes and identify the contributions of scope, reference, lexical knowledge and numerical structure. FOLLIE provides a French experimental basis for studying the representations and assumptions that connect sentence interpretation to deductive inference.
articles.titleCn: FOLLIE：基于法语句子及其一阶逻辑表示的第一数据集的自动推理
articles.abstractCn: FOLLIE（用于法语语言推理和蕴涵的一阶逻辑）将法语句子、组合式一阶表示和自动化自然语言推理（NLI）连接起来。作为首个法语NLI准备好的、从自然语言到一阶逻辑的资源，它包含19,983条推理记录和36,987个非空句子-槽位-公式映射，这些映射来自六个异构的NLI数据源，保留了法语词汇材料和源问题结构。其银标注由一个神经-符号管道生成，包含111个单独识别的LLM辅助添加。该构建过程结合了词形句法分析、概率条件下的范畴多标签分类、语法证明搜索、话语表示和一阶语义构建。分阶段实验显示出推导覆盖率的显著提升；对合取分布、逻辑运算符发生和范围交替的分析特征化了该资源。接着我们开发了一个自动推理引擎，其输入条件背景理论处理词汇关系、量化、数量、事件结构和时间依赖。Prover9提供蕴涵和矛盾证明，而Mace4支持有界一致性检查。在所有335个FraCaS-FR问题上，三向准确率为65.37%；在300个GQNLI-FR问题上为70.33%；在9,399条跨分割的合格SICK-FR记录上为71.35%。在41.49%、37.00%和15.05%的承诺覆盖率下，与参考标签的协议分别为93.53%、100.00%和98.66%。已处理的构造、公理模式和证明分析解释了这些结果，并识别了范围、指称、词汇知识和数值结构的贡献。FOLLIE为研究将句子解释与演绎推理连接起来的表示和假设提供了法语的实验基础。

articles.title: Conditional Calibration Contracts under Coupled Load: A Branch-Aware Audit of Switched Inference
articles.abstract: Bursty serving changes both queue states and the population selected for each model. We study conditional calibration contracts as a specification to be validated, rather than a certified property of an existing router. CA-MHD combines load-coupled distillation, closed-loop replay and a cost-informed Schmitt router in a discrete-event simulator with a hardware service table. Across 40 cells (ten training seeds and four content-load coupling levels), we distinguish the original teacher, frozen wide heads on an adapted trunk, and the narrow student. A common teacher-trajectory audit has median absolute student-teacher deficit 0.06 percentage points, but does not certify the student-selected deployment support. Historical results use a kernel correctness gap, not the published SmoothECE; we separately prove selected-branch composition for a residual functional at a common fixed scale. The deployed wide branch has lower ordinal accuracy than the original teacher in all 40 cells. Same-checkpoint student-only serving has lower historical ordinal gap in 27/40 cells; routing also exposes violation tails up to 17.5 percent. Student p99 latency remains above the 1.5 ms target. Retrospective temporal recalibration improves the ordinal gap in 39/40 cells, but causal delayed-label availability is unverified and no incremental per-mode benefit is detected after multiplicity adjustment. An in-sample CUSUM detects 30/40 checkpoint changes at five historical false alarms, with no prospective false-alarm guarantee. These findings support a branch-aware audit and a scoped negative result, not demonstrated routing superiority. Independent budgets, selected-support validation and net utility under a satisfied SLA remain open.
articles.comment: 12 pages including references and appendices, ACM sigconf. Historical 40-cell campaign (10 training seeds x 4 coupling levels), with separate three-seed sweeps/ablations. Includes proofs, prospective FIFO mechanism checks, and limitations; prospective contract validation remains open
articles.titleCn: 耦合负载下的条件校准合约：一种基于分支感知的切换推理审计
articles.abstractCn: 突发服务会改变队列状态和每个模型所选的种群。我们将条件校准合约作为待验证的规范，而不是现有路由器的一项认证属性。CA-MHD将负载耦合蒸馏、闭环重放和成本感知施密特路由结合在一个具有硬件服务表的离散事件模拟器中。在40个单元（十个训练种子和四个内容负载耦合级别）中，我们区分了原始教师、适配主干上的冻结宽头以及窄学生。常见的教师轨迹审计的中值绝对学生-教师差距为0.06个百分点，但并未认证学生所选的部署支持。历史结果使用核正确性差距，而非已发布的SmoothECE；我们分别证明了在公共固定尺度下残差函数的选定分支组合。部署的宽分支在所有40个单元中都比原始教师具有较低的序数准确率。相同检查点仅学生服务在27/40个单元中具有较低的历史序数差距；路由也暴露了高达17.5%的违规尾部。学生p99延迟仍然高于1.5毫秒的目标。回顾性时间重新校准在39/40个单元中改善了序数差距，但因果延迟标签可用性未经验证，在多重性调整后未检测到每模式的增量收益。样本内CUSUM检测到40个单元中的30个检查点变化，在五个历史误报中，没有前瞻性误报保证。这些发现支持分支感知审计和范围负结果，而非已证明的路由优越性。独立预算、选定支持验证和满足SLA下的净效用仍然是开放的。

articles.title: Order-Only On-Policy Distillation
articles.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own generations by matching the teacher's token probabilities. These probabilities entangle two kinds of information: which tokens the teacher prefers, and how confident it is. The latter reflects the teacher's own capacity and calibration, which a smaller student may be unable to reproduce. Because the teacher temperature changes these values without changing the ordering, OPD is also sensitive to the temperature choice. We ask whether the teacher's ordering of candidate tokens is enough, and propose Order-Only On-Policy Distillation (O$^{3}$PD). At each student-generated prefix, O$^{3}$PD trains the student to reproduce the order of the teacher's top-$K$ tokens, without fitting their probability values. The objective is therefore invariant to the teacher temperature and needs no temperature tuning. Across six teacher--student pairs, O$^{3}$PD outperforms OPD on the average over HMMT25, AIME24, and AIME25 in every pair, by up to 2.9 points, with gains of up to 5.6 points on AIME25. Other ranking losses yield similar gains, so the benefit comes from ordinal supervision itself. Analysis shows that O$^{3}$PD departs further from the teacher's probabilities than OPD, yet reproduces its ranking more faithfully and yields a stronger student. The ranking, not the probability values, thus carries the knowledge that on-policy distillation needs to transfer.
articles.titleCn: 仅基于目标策略的蒸馏
articles.abstractCn: 策略内蒸馏（OPD）通过匹配教师模型的token概率来训练学生模型，这些概率包含了两种信息：教师更倾向于哪些token，以及教师的置信度。后者反映了教师自身的容量和校准，较小的学生模型可能无法复制这些特性。由于教师模型的温度会改变这些值而不改变排序，OPD对温度的选择也很敏感。我们探讨了教师对候选token的排序是否足够，并提出了仅排序策略内蒸馏（O$^{3}$PD）。在每次学生生成的prefix中，O$^{3}$PD训练学生复制教师模型top-K token的排序，而不拟合它们的概率值。因此，其目标与教师温度无关，无需温度调校。在六个教师-学生对中，O$^{3}$PD在HMMT25、AIME24和AIME25上的平均表现优于OPD，提升幅度高达2.9分，在AIME25上提升幅度高达5.6分。其他排名损失也带来了类似的提升，因此这种优势来源于序数监督本身。分析表明，O$^{3}$PD与教师模型的概率相比OPD偏离更远，但更忠实地复制了其排序，并生成了更强的学生模型。因此，是排序而非概率值携带了策略内蒸馏需要传递的知识。

articles.title: Consolidating Reasoning with Test-Time Training
articles.abstract: Effective multi-agent collaboration requires finalizing solutions from reasoning that is distributed across the individual attempts of many agents. However, useful intermediate reasoning can remain unexploited when collaboration is limited to voting on conclusions reached among individual agents, or aggregating long, noisy collections of reasoning trajectories in context. In this work, we propose TTT-Consolidate, a framework that uses multi-agent reasoning trajectories as adaptation data to improve a model's subsequent reasoning. TTT-Consolidate jointly consolidates trajectories into parametric representations through test-time training, then generates a new solution by conditioning on the consolidated information. We meta-learn how to consolidate using bi-level optimization at training time, where an inner loop encodes reasoning trajectories into a lightweight LoRA adapter, and an outer loop learns meta-parameters for the inner loop such that the consolidation is helpful for the model to synthesize a final solution. As no large-scale corpus of diverse reasoning trajectories exists for training aggregation methods, we construct the OpenParallelThinking corpus composed of 12,810 math problems paired with a mixture of trajectories from six LLMs. Evaluated on challenging math and STEM benchmarks, TTT-Consolidate outperforms the best aggregation baselines by up to 20 percentage points, even under matched compute and runtime settings, with the gap widening at larger model scales. TTT-Consolidate also recovers from unsuccessful individual trajectories more robustly, an ability that improves as the number of available (even incorrect) trajectories increases. Finally, we demonstrate that TTT-Consolidate benefits from both SFT and RL-based outer loop objectives. We will release TTT-Consolidate and OpenParallelThinking for use in future work on reasoning aggregation.
articles.comment: NeurIPS 2026, 25 pages, test-time training, reasoning aggregation, meta-learning
articles.titleCn: 在测试时进行训练以巩固推理
articles.abstractCn: 有效的多智能体协作需要从分布在许多智能体个体尝试中的推理中最终确定解决方案。然而，当协作仅限于对智能体个体达成的结论进行投票，或是在情境中对大量冗长的噪声推理轨迹进行聚合时，有用的中间推理可能仍然未被利用。在这项工作中，我们提出了TTT-Consolidate框架，该框架使用多智能体推理轨迹作为自适应数据来改进模型的后续推理。TTT-Consolidate通过测试时训练将轨迹联合整合为参数化表示，然后基于整合的信息生成新的解决方案。我们通过训练时的双层优化元学习如何进行整合，其中内层循环将推理轨迹编码为轻量级的LoRA适配器，外层循环学习内层循环的元参数，使得整合有助于模型合成最终解决方案。由于没有大规模的多样化推理轨迹语料库用于训练聚合方法，我们构建了包含12,810道数学问题与六种大型语言模型轨迹混合的OpenParallelThinking语料库。在具有挑战性的数学和STEM基准测试上，TTT-Consolidate在匹配的计算和运行时设置下，甚至比最佳聚合基线高出20个百分点，且在更大的模型规模下差距进一步扩大。TTT-Consolidate还能更稳健地从不成功的个体轨迹中恢复，这种能力随着可用轨迹（即使是不正确的）数量的增加而提高。最后，我们证明TTT-Consolidate同时受益于SFT和基于RL的外层循环目标。我们将发布TTT-Consolidate和OpenParallelThinking，供未来推理聚合研究使用。

articles.title: ParetoSaddler: Pareto-Guided Optimization of Agent Harnesses for Quality and Cost
articles.abstract: Harness optimization can substantially improve LLM agents without modifying model weights, but existing methods primarily optimize response quality. Extending them to joint quality--cost optimization introduces a challenge: applying the deployment preference during intermediate updates can prematurely reject candidates that are valuable for later improvements. We introduce ParetoSaddler, which addresses this mismatch by separating intermediate candidate promotion from final deployment selection. At each iteration, an optimizer updates a parent harness to produce a candidate, and then compares the two over repeated executions and uses Bayesian bootstrap Pareto support to promote candidates showing credible progress in either quality or cost. Promoted candidates receive broader development evaluation and remain available as parents for later optimization steps. We evaluate ParetoSaddler on ClawMark and GAIA2 using domain-disjoint splits. On ClawMark, ParetoSaddler improves quality from 70.86\% to 81.35\% while reducing cost from \$1.17 to \$1.01 per task; on GAIA2, it improves quality from 56.22\% to 62.89\% while reducing cost from \$0.78 to \$0.45 per task. The Pareto-selected harnesses also achieve higher quality at lower cost than quality-only harness optimization. Analysis shows that Pareto-aware optimization retains intermediate candidates that would be discarded by deployment preference but can support later improvements, while Bayesian bootstrap screening filters out candidates whose gains are weakly supported across runs.
articles.comment: Project website and code will be available at https://aka.ms/ParetoSaddler-website
articles.titleCn: ParetoSaddler：基于Pareto引导的智能体框架优化，以实现质量和成本的最优化
articles.abstractCn: 利用优化可以显著提升大语言模型代理的性能，而无需修改模型权重，但现有方法主要优化响应质量。将它们扩展到联合质量-成本优化会带来一个挑战：在中间更新过程中应用部署偏好可能会过早地拒绝对后期改进有价值候选者。我们引入了ParetoSaddler，它通过将中间候选者提升与最终部署选择分离来解决这种不匹配问题。在每次迭代中，优化器更新父代理以生成候选者，然后通过重复执行比较这两个候选者，并使用贝叶斯引导Pareto支持来提升在质量或成本方面显示出可信进展的候选者。被提升的候选者将接受更广泛的开发评估，并作为后期优化步骤的父代保留。我们在ClawMark和GAIA2上使用领域不交的划分评估了ParetoSaddler。在ClawMark上，ParetoSaddler将质量从70.86%提升至81.35%，同时将每项任务的成本从1.17美元降至1.01美元；在GAIA2上，它将质量从56.22%提升至62.89%，同时将每项任务的成本从0.78美元降至0.45美元。Pareto选择的代理在更低的成本下实现了更高的质量，优于仅优化质量的代理。分析表明，Pareto感知优化保留了部署偏好会丢弃但能支持后期改进的中间候选者，而贝叶斯引导筛选则过滤掉了跨运行增益较弱支持的候选者。

articles.title: How Green Is Your Manifesto? Scoring Environmental Positions in the 2024 EU Elections with an LLM Panel
articles.abstract: Locating political parties on environmental and climate policy is central to the study of party competition, yet the established instruments, expert surveys and the hand coding of manifestos, are costly, periodic, and slow to extend to new documents. We ask whether a panel of large language models can serve as a cheaper and reproducible alternative. Treating each manifesto as a set of sentences, three models from independent providers score every sentence on two dimensions, environmental protection and climate change, separating a party's position on an issue from the salience it gives it, and the judgments are averaged to the manifesto level. Agreement across the models is retained as a built-in reliability signal. We apply the panel to 41 manifestos from the 2024 European Parliament election, covering Austria, France, Germany, Italy, Spain, and the European party families, and validate it against the 2024 Chapel Hill Expert Survey for the 25 parties with a like-for-like expert benchmark, using the other manifestos as diagnostic cases. The panel recovers the expert ordering of parties with strong rank agreement on both dimensions, while reading them as systematically greener than experts do, a gap we interpret as the distance between manifesto promise and governing record. Inter-model disagreement modestly flags where the instrument errs, and position and salience prove related for environmental protection but independent for climate change. The result is a transparent, low-cost, and multilingual instrument that complements rather than replaces expert and hand-coded approaches; the prompt, code, and manifesto-level results are released openly.
articles.titleCn: 你的宣言有多绿色？用LLM小组为2024年欧盟选举中的环境立场打分
articles.abstractCn: 在环境与气候政策上定位政党是政党竞争研究的核心，然而现成的工具、专家调查和宣言的手工编码都成本高昂、周期性长，且难以快速扩展到新文件。我们探讨了大型语言模型组合是否可以作为一种更经济且可重复使用的替代方案。将每个宣言视为一组句子，来自三个独立提供者的三个模型在两个维度——环境保护和气候变化——上对每句话进行评分，将政党的立场与其对议题的重视程度分开，并将评分平均到宣言层面。模型间的共识被保留为内置的可靠性信号。我们将该模型应用于2024年欧洲议会选举的41份宣言，涵盖奥地利、法国、德国、意大利、西班牙以及欧洲政党家庭，并通过与其他宣言作为诊断案例，将其与2024年教堂山专家调查进行对比验证，该调查针对25个政党进行了同等标准的专家基准测试。该模型恢复了专家对政党排序的一致性，且系统性地认为这些政党比专家评估的更为环保，我们将这一差距解读为宣言承诺与执政记录之间的距离。模型间的分歧适度地指出了工具的误差所在，而立场与重视程度在环境保护议题上相关，在气候变化议题上则独立。这一结果是一种透明、低成本、多语言的工具，它补充而非取代了专家和手工编码方法；提示、代码和宣言层面的结果均公开发布。

articles.title: ClickSight: An LLM Framework for Interpreting Student Clickstreams Through Learning Strategies
articles.abstract: Digital learning environments produce rich clickstream data that can reveal how students approach learning tasks, yet interpreting these fine-grained traces often requires substantial expert effort. We introduce ClickSight, a framework for interpreting student clickstreams through learning strategies defined in the literature. Given a student clickstream and a predefined set of learning strategies, ClickSight uses a staged LLM-based pipeline to identify strategy-relevant evidence, assess adherence to each strategy, and generate an evidence-grounded interpretation of the student's behavior. We evaluate ClickSight across two learning environments, 365 students, and 12 model backbones using an expert-grounded quality rubric and an LLM judge calibrated with human-expert ratings. Our results show that ClickSight can generate high-quality strategy-based interpretations across different models and environments, with reasoning models performing more consistently than instruction-tuned counterparts. We further find that providing external clickstream-extracted guidance can improve interpretation quality for strategies that require precise quantitative information from the trace. By connecting fine-grained clickstreams with theoretically defined learning strategies and preserving the evidence underlying each judgment, ClickSight provides a flexible approach for studying student behavior in digital learning environments.
articles.comment: 29 pages, 12 figures, 19 tables. Under review. Code: https://github.com/epfl-ml4ed/ClickSight-CEAI
articles.titleCn: ClickSight：一种通过学习策略解释学生点击流的LLM框架
articles.abstractCn: 数字学习环境会产生丰富的点击流数据，这些数据能够揭示学生如何处理学习任务，然而解读这些细粒度轨迹往往需要大量的专家投入。我们介绍了ClickSight框架，该框架通过文献中定义的学习策略来解读学生的点击流。给定一个学生的点击流和预定义的学习策略集合，ClickSight使用基于LLM的分层管道来识别与策略相关的证据，评估对每个策略的遵循程度，并生成基于证据的学生行为解读。我们使用专家基准质量评估标准和经过人类专家评分校准的LLM裁判，在两个学习环境、365名学生和12个模型主干上评估了ClickSight。我们的结果表明，ClickSight能够在不同的模型和环境生成高质量的基于策略的解读，推理模型的表现比指令调优模型更稳定。我们进一步发现，提供外部点击流提取的指导可以提高需要从轨迹中获取精确定量信息的策略的解读质量。通过将细粒度点击流与理论上定义的学习策略相连接，并保留每个判断背后的证据，ClickSight为研究数字学习环境中的学生行为提供了一种灵活的方法。

articles.title: CULTURE-CMT: Benchmarking Contextualized Social Media Translation
articles.abstract: Social-media comments are interactions, yet they are often translated and evaluated as isolated text. This mismatch is especially problematic when meaning depends on surrounding discussion, community-specific slang, or culturally situated expressions. We introduce CULTURE-CMT, a Chinese-English benchmark for contextualized social-media comment translation that restores the post and conversational context naturally available to users. Its 572 manually verified examples are organized into Slang, Context, and Both, enabling diagnostic analysis of distinct and interacting sources of translation difficulty. To support scalable evaluation, we further develop a retrieval-augmented cultural-effectiveness Judger that combines a calibrated scoring model with dynamically retrieved cultural knowledge. CULTURE-CMT reveals several non-trivial patterns. Providing interaction context improves most model configurations, but does not eliminate culturally ineffective translations. Examples requiring both contextual grounding and culturally situated language remain substantially more difficult than either source of difficulty alone. Moreover, larger models are not consistently better, and thinking produces highly model-dependent gains, including occasional degradation. In contrast, a 27B model adapted on benchmark-disjoint social-media data achieves the lowest observed invalidity rate among the evaluated configurations under thinking inference with context. Together, these results suggest that realistic social-media translation is not simply a matter of scaling models or reasoning longer, but of learning to translate meaning as it is constructed within evolving online interactions.
articles.titleCn: CULTURE-CMT：面向情境化社交媒体翻译的基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 社交媒体评论是互动行为，但它们往往被当作孤立文本进行翻译和评估。这种不匹配在意义依赖于周边讨论、特定社群俚语或文化特定表达时尤其成问题。我们介绍了CULTURE-CMT，一个用于情境化社交媒体评论翻译的中英双语文本基准，它自然地恢复了用户可获得的帖子和对话背景。其572个经过人工验证的例子被分为俚语、情境和两者兼具三类，从而能够对不同的翻译困难来源及其相互作用进行诊断分析。为了支持可扩展的评估，我们进一步开发了一个检索增强的文化效果评判器，它结合了校准评分模型和动态检索的文化知识。CULTURE-CMT揭示了几种非平凡的规律。提供互动背景能改善大多数模型配置，但并不能消除文化效果不佳的翻译。需要同时具备情境基础和文化特定语言例子的难度，仍然远高于单独任何一种困难来源。此外，更大的模型并不总是更好，思考过程会产生高度依赖模型的收益，包括偶尔的退化。相比之下，一个在基准无关的社交媒体数据上调整的27B模型，在带情境的思考推理下，在评估配置中实现了最低的无效率。综合这些结果，表明现实的社交媒体翻译并非简单地通过扩展模型或延长推理时间就能解决，而是要学会在不断发展的在线互动中构建意义。

articles.title: Switch-SWE: Do Coding Agents Hold Focus When Switching Between Unfinished Tasks?
articles.abstract: Software development sessions often involve several unfinished tasks rather than one issue carried through to completion. As coding agents take on repository-level development, they need to recover an earlier task's requirements and partial progress after intervening work. Existing repository-level benchmarks typically score one issue-to-patch episode and do not directly measure whether an agent can resume a task after advancing other unfinished work in the same repository. We introduce \textbf{\ourmethod}, a benchmark for focus-task resumption in sessions that interleave unfinished tasks drawn from the same source repository, with a persistent checkout for each task. Each focus task is evaluated in matched uninterrupted and switched sessions with identical focus requirements and executable verifiers. The switched session interleaves ordered stages from other unfinished tasks in the same repository, while only the final focus patch is scored. \ourmethod~contains 200 focus tasks from 19 Python repositories, reconstructed from issue, pull-request, and review histories and rendered as 400 matched session specifications. Across 7 coding agents, interleaved unfinished work produces an average focus-task resolution gap of 11.5 percentage points, ranging from 6.0 to 15.0 percentage points. Trajectory analysis identifies cross-task requirement confusion and loss of task state as recurrent resumption behaviors. We introduce a plug-in context-management module that selects task-relevant history and maintains concise task-state summaries. On OpenCode, the module improves focus-task completion under same-repository task switching by 5.5 to 15.5 percentage points across the evaluated models. Code is available at github.com/Miraclecsc/Switch-SWE.
articles.titleCn: 切换-SWE：在切换未完成任务时，编码代理是否保持专注？
articles.abstractCn: 软件开发过程中往往涉及多个未完成的任务，而非单一问题从始至终完成。随着编码代理承担仓库级别的开发工作，它们需要在介入工作后恢复早期任务的需求和部分进展。现有的仓库级别基准通常只评估一个问题到补丁的单一场景，并未直接衡量代理是否能在处理同一仓库中其他未完成工作后继续执行任务。我们引入了\textbf{\ourmethod}，这是一个用于在涉及来自同一源代码仓库的未完成任务交错执行的场景中，针对焦点任务恢复的基准，每个任务都有持续的检出。每个焦点任务在匹配的不间断和切换会话中进行评估，会话具有相同的需求和可执行验证器。切换会话中交错插入同一仓库中其他未完成任务的有序阶段，但仅评分最终焦点补丁。\ourmethod~包含从19个Python仓库中提取的200个焦点任务，这些任务根据问题、拉取请求和评审历史重建，并渲染为400个匹配的会话规范。在7个编码代理中，交错未完成工作导致平均焦点任务解决差距为11.5个百分点，范围在6.0到15.0个百分点之间。轨迹分析识别出跨任务需求混淆和任务状态丢失是常见的恢复行为。我们引入了一个插件式上下文管理模块，该模块选择与任务相关的历史记录并维护简洁的任务状态摘要。在OpenCode上，该模块在相同仓库任务切换中提高了焦点任务的完成率，在评估的模型中提升了5.5到15.5个百分点。代码可在github.com/Miraclecsc/Switch-SWE获取。

articles.title: Scaling Makes It Possible: How Large Models Master Impossible Languages
articles.abstract: While language models (LMs) excel in natural language tasks, their ability to learn impossible languages--those that violate the structural, cognitive, or logical constraints that make human languages learnable and functional--remains debatable. This controversy is further fueled by a divide between linguistic theorists and empirical researchers working with small-scale LMs. To address this controversy, we introduce semantic coherence. This concept measures how effectively semantic information is expressed in language structures and examines the learning capabilities of LMs across multiple scales. By fine-tuning billion-parameter LMs on impossible language samples, we demonstrate that larger LMs achieve similar performance on impossible and possible languages, whereas million-parameter LMs exhibit significant degradation when trained on impossible languages. This performance gap widens as semantic complexity increases. We further show that scaling up the LM size fundamentally shifts the learning focus from grammatical rules to semantic understanding, with billion-scale LMs exhibiting a threefold reduction in sensitivity to low-level linguistic perturbations while maintaining stable performance under high-level semantic perturbations.
articles.comment: 17 pages, 7 figures, including 6 pages of supplementary information
articles.titleCn: 规模使其成为可能：大型模型如何掌握不可能的语言
articles.abstractCn: 尽管语言模型（LMs）在自然语言任务中表现出色，但它们学习不可能语言的能力——即违反使人类语言可学习和功能化的结构、认知或逻辑约束的语言——仍然存在争议。这场争议进一步加剧了语言理论家与使用小规模LMs进行实证研究的学者之间的分歧。为解决这一争议，我们引入了语义连贯性概念。该概念衡量语义信息在语言结构中表达的效率，并考察LMs在多个尺度上的学习能力。通过在不可能语言样本上微调百亿参数的LMs，我们证明，更大规模的LMs在可能和不可能语言上的表现相似，而百万参数的LMs在训练不可能语言时表现出显著的性能下降。随着语义复杂性的增加，这种性能差距进一步扩大。我们进一步表明，扩大LM规模从根本上改变了学习重点，从语法规则转向语义理解，百亿规模的LMs对低级语言扰动的敏感性降低了三倍，同时在高级语义扰动下保持稳定性能。

articles.title: MedPsy: State-of-the-Art Small Medical Language Models for Efficient Edge Deployment
articles.abstract: Medical language models promise expert clinical support, but the strongest open-source LLMs remain too large for private edge-device deployment, while compact medical models still trail substantially on knowledge-intensive and real-world healthcare tasks. Reasoning models that fit edge memory budgets can produce long reasoning traces, increasing sequential decoding, end-to-end latency, energy consumption, and KV-cache memory pressure. We present MedPsy, a family of text-only 1.7B and 4B medical language models designed for edge deployment, targeting this accuracy-generation-efficiency trade-off. Our recipe combines a synthetic medical data pipeline over biology, medicine, and health seeds with chain-of-thought targets from a 235B medical-focused LLM teacher; a four-stage post-training curriculum comprising two SFT stages followed by two RL stages with hard-sample mining; and an edge deployment evaluation spanning multiple GGUF quantization variants and real-device inference on laptop and smartphone hardware. On seven closed-ended medical benchmarks, MedPsy-4B surpasses MedGemma-1.5-4B by 19.34 points and matches MedGemma-27B while being 6.75x smaller; MedPsy-1.7B outperforms MedGemma-1.5-4B by 11.42 points despite being less than half its size. On HealthBench-Hard, MedPsy-4B surpasses MedGemma-27B by 15.33 points, while MedPsy-1.7B surpasses it by 11.66 points despite being ~16x smaller. Beyond accuracy, MedPsy reduces average response length by 1.7x (1.7B) and 3.2x (4B) versus its Qwen3 backbones, while Q4_K_M quantization preserves the aggregate score within 1 point of BF16 with ~69% lower disk footprint. In real-device inference, MedPsy-4B's shorter generations translate into 75% lower median end-to-end latency and estimated energy per answer than its Qwen3 backbone at matched quantization, while peak RAM remains below 5 GB across our tested laptop and smartphone configurations.
articles.titleCn: MedPsy：用于高效边缘部署的最先进小型医疗语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 医学语言模型承诺提供专家级临床支持，但最强的开源大语言模型仍然过大，无法部署于私有边缘设备，而紧凑型医学模型在知识密集型和现实医疗任务上仍有显著差距。适合边缘内存预算的推理模型能产生长推理轨迹，增加序列解码、端到端延迟、能耗和KV缓存内存压力。我们提出了MedPsy，一个专为边缘部署设计的文本型1.7B和4B医学语言模型系列，旨在解决准确率生成效率的权衡问题。我们的方法结合了跨越生物学、医学和健康种子的合成医学数据管道，以及来自一个235B医学专注LLM教师的思维链目标；一个包含两个SFT阶段和两个带硬样本挖掘的RL阶段的四阶段后训练课程；以及涵盖多种GGUF量化变体和真实设备（笔记本电脑和智能手机硬件）推理的边缘部署评估。在七个封闭式医学基准测试中，MedPsy-4B比MedGemma-1.5-4B高19.34分，与MedGemma-27B持平，但体积小6.75倍；MedPsy-1.7B虽不到其一半大小，却比MedGemma-1.5-4B高11.42分。在HealthBench-Hard上，MedPsy-4B比MedGemma-27B高15.33分，MedPsy-1.7B虽约小16倍，却高11.66分。除了准确率，MedPsy相比其Qwen3骨干模型平均响应长度减少1.7倍（1.7B）和3.2倍（4B），而Q4_K_M量化在约69%更小的磁盘占用下，总分与BF16相差不到1分。在真实设备推理中，MedPsy-4B较匹配量化的Qwen3骨干模型生成的更短，导致中位数端到端延迟降低75%，每条回答的能耗估计也降低75%，而我们测试的笔记本电脑和智能手机配置中峰值RAM始终低于5GB。

articles.title: Retrieval-Enhanced Cultural Evaluation for Social Media Translation Training
articles.abstract: Social media translation requires preserving meaning while capturing the cultural nuances of user-generated content (UGC). However, gaps in the cultural knowledge of LLM-based evaluators can lead to inaccurate assessments and unreliable training rewards. To improve these signals, we use retrieval-enhanced cultural evaluation to train CUE-MT, a family of social media translation models. A calibrated, domain-specific Judger guides supervised data refinement and is augmented by an Agent for hard-example mining and reinforcement learning. The Agent retrieves relevant external evidence as needed and distills it into concise hints that the Judger uses to score translations and assign rewards. Across 9B, 27B, and 35B-A3B backbones, CUE-MT outperforms the evaluated open-source baselines of comparable size on CUE-MT-Bench and three public benchmarks. Human evaluation on CUE-MT-Bench shows cultural effectiveness gains of 7.44-15.12 percentage points over the strongest external baseline in each size group. Retrieval improves the Judger's four-way classification accuracy by 8.07 percentage points over a matched no-retrieval baseline that uses LLM-generated hints alone. Training ablations further support the combination of hard-example mining and Agent-enhanced rewards.
articles.titleCn: 基于检索增强的文化评估方法用于社交媒体翻译培训
articles.abstractCn: 社交媒体翻译需要在保留意义的同时捕捉用户生成内容（UGC）的文化细微之处。然而，基于LLM的评估者的文化知识差距会导致评估不准确和训练奖励不可靠。为了改进这些信号，我们使用检索增强的文化评估来训练CUE-MT，这是一系列社交媒体翻译模型。经过校准的特定领域判官指导监督数据的优化，并通过用于难例挖掘和强化学习的代理进行增强。代理根据需要检索相关外部证据，并将其提炼成简洁的提示，供判官用于评分翻译和分配奖励。在9B、27B和35B-A3B主干上，CUE-MT在CUE-MT-Bench和三个公开基准上优于同等规模的评估开源基线。在CUE-MT-Bench上的人类评估显示，在每个规模组中，与最强外部基线相比，文化有效性提升了7.44-15.12个百分点。检索使判官的四向分类准确率比仅使用LLM生成的提示的匹配无检索基线提高了8.07个百分点。训练消融实验进一步支持了难例挖掘和代理增强奖励的结合。

articles.title: To Align Long, Plan Short: Simulating Diverse Profile-Aligned Students by Realizing Short-Term Plans in Long-Horizon Learning Environments
articles.abstract: Simulated students offer a scalable way to test learning platforms and AI tutors before deployment with real students and to augment scarce data for studying learning at scale. Existing LLM-based simulators primarily target short, language-centered interactions. In open-ended learning environments, however, student behavior emerges from patterns across long-horizon interaction trajectories, where turn-level prompting can drift from an assigned behavior profile. We introduce ALPS (Align Long-term by Planning Short-term), a hierarchical simulated student conditioned on observable, environment-specific behavior profiles. Rather than selecting every action independently, ALPS alternates between planning profile-aligned task segments and generating the corresponding actions. We evaluate ALPS in both data-sufficient and data-scarce settings, where supervision comes either from real student trajectories or from a teacher LLM. Across both settings, we compare in-context learning (ICL), supervised fine-tuning (SFT), reward-ranked fine-tuning (RAFT), and their sequential combination (SFT followed by RAFT). Experiments in an inquiry-based physics game and a pharmacy simulation evaluate behavioral density and coverage against held-out real data, and profile consistency using a human-aligned LLM judge. Across both settings, ALPS consistently outperforms turn-level generation, achieving comparable density and judge pass rates under scarce supervision, although coverage remains lower. These results show that hierarchical planning enables faithful, profile-aligned simulation over long interaction horizons, even with limited real student data.
articles.titleCn: 着眼长远，规划短期：通过在长期学习环境中实现短期计划来模拟多样化的档案对齐学生
articles.abstractCn: 模拟学生提供了一种可扩展的方法，用于在真实学生部署前测试学习平台和AI导师，并增强用于大规模学习研究的数据稀缺性。现有的基于大型语言模型（LLM）的模拟器主要针对短、以语言为中心的交互。然而，在开放式学习环境中，学生的行为是从长期交互轨迹中的模式中产生的，其中回合级别的提示可能会偏离分配的行为配置文件。我们引入了ALPS（通过短期规划对齐长期），这是一种基于可观察的环境特定行为配置文件的分层模拟学生。ALPS不是独立地选择每个动作，而是交替规划与配置文件对齐的任务段并生成相应的动作。我们在数据充足和数据稀缺的设置中评估ALPS，其中监督来自真实学生轨迹或教师LLM。在两种设置中，我们比较了情境学习（ICL）、监督微调（SFT）、奖励排序微调（RAFT）及其顺序组合（SFT后接RAFT）。在一个基于探究的物理游戏和一个药店模拟中进行的实验评估了行为密度和覆盖率，与保留的真实数据对比，并使用与人类对齐的LLM裁判评估配置文件一致性。在两种设置中，ALPS始终优于回合级别生成，在稀缺监督下实现了相当的密度和裁判通过率，尽管覆盖率仍然较低。这些结果表明，分层规划即使在有限的真实学生数据下也能在长期交互范围内实现忠实、与配置文件对齐的模拟。

articles.title: TrackMem: Tracking Evolving Beliefs in Long-Horizon Financial Dialogue
articles.abstract: Memory systems for LLM agents are evaluated mostly on social dialogue, where facts accumulate and rarely change, so remembering reduces largely to finding the turn in which something was said. Financial dialogue breaks this assumption: figures are revised, stances shift without being restated, rules stated once govern later questions, and a single company is discussed under several analytical lenses. Memory systems that retrieve the passages most similar to a question, or the most recent ones, therefore return superseded values, miss rules that share no wording with the question, and cannot recover a stance spread across sessions. We present TrackMem, a per-speaker graph memory that tracks the history of figures, separates perspectives by entity and lens, and preserves each speaker's actions in chronological order. To evaluate it, we introduce FinLoCoMo, a benchmark of 15 long-horizon investment conversations with 765 questions in two splits: one following the LoCoMo categories and one targeting four failure modes. With two readers, TrackMem outperforms existing memory systems on both splits. On the failure-mode split it reaches 73.9% macro accuracy against 69.4% for the strongest baseline, with the largest gains on questions about revised figures (86.5% against 73.4%).
articles.titleCn: TrackMem：在长时金融对话中追踪演变的信念
articles.abstractCn: 用于大语言模型代理的记忆系统主要在社交对话中进行评估，其中事实会不断积累且很少改变，因此记忆主要简化为找到某事被提及的回合。金融对话打破了这一假设：数字会被修订，立场会转变而不重申，一次陈述的规则会支配后续问题，且单个公司会从多个分析视角进行讨论。因此，检索与问题最相似的段落或最新段落的记忆系统会返回过时值，遗漏与问题措辞无关的规则，且无法恢复跨会话的立场。我们提出了TrackMem，这是一种按发言人划分的图记忆系统，它追踪数字的历史，通过实体和视角分离，并按时间顺序保留每个发言人的行为。为了评估它，我们引入了FinLoCoMo，这是一个包含15个长时投资对话的基准，其中有765个问题，分为两个分割：一个遵循LoCoMo类别，另一个针对四种失败模式。使用两个阅读器，TrackMem在两个分割中都优于现有的记忆系统。在失败模式分割中，它达到了73.9%的宏观准确率，而最强的基线为69.4%，在关于修订数字的问题上取得了最大提升（86.5%对73.4%）。

articles.title: Better Answers, Weaker Evidence Control: Evidence Bypass in On-Policy Distillation
articles.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) can improve answer accuracy while weakening responsiveness to supporting evidence. We investigate this separation in scientific-document question answering through matched document interventions that change the supported answer while preserving the question and unrelated context. We identify evidence bypass: a student retains an originally correct answer after the document changes to support a different one. On QASPER with a Qwen3-4B student, standard OPD raises original-document accuracy by 3.4 percentage points, lowers counterfactual accuracy by 5.3 points, and increases bypass by 15.7 points; the same directional pattern appears on PeerQA. Controlled perturbations localize the shift to answer-critical evidence, and bypass grows with the student's pre-distillation closed-book preference for the original answer. A factorized study of teacher targets, privileged information, divergence, and supervision density finds that explicitly supplying the teacher with annotated answer-critical spans yields the largest joint improvement in evidence response and claim support. These findings motivate Evidence-Paired OPD (EP-OPD), which combines on-policy supervision on matched documents supporting different answers to the same question with an answer-level margin that favors each document's supported answer over its paired alternative. Across both datasets and two student sizes, EP-OPD recovers 54-66% of standard OPD's counterfactual-accuracy loss while preserving 80-85% of its original-document accuracy gain. Our results establish evidence responsiveness as a distinct training and evaluation target alongside answer accuracy. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/RuoranXu/EP-OPD.
articles.titleCn: 更好的答案，更弱的证据控制：在线策略蒸馏中的证据绕过
articles.abstractCn: 策略内蒸馏（OPD）可以提高答案的准确性，但会削弱对支持证据的响应性。我们通过匹配文档干预（改变支持答案的文档，同时保留问题和无关上下文）来研究科学文献问答中的这种分离现象。我们发现了证据绕过现象：学生能在文档改变以支持不同答案后，仍然保留原本正确的答案。在QASPER上使用Qwen3-4B学生时，标准OPD将原始文档准确性提高了3.4个百分点，降低了反事实准确性5.3个百分点，并将绕过现象增加了15.7个百分点；在PeerQA上同样出现了相同的趋势。受控扰动将这种转变定位到答案关键证据上，绕过现象的增长与学生蒸馏前的闭卷偏好原始答案有关。对教师目标、特权信息、差异和监督密度的分解研究表明，明确向教师提供标注的答案关键跨度，能在证据响应和主张支持方面带来最大的联合改进。这些发现启发了证据配对OPD（EP-OPD），它结合了支持同一问题不同答案的匹配文档上的策略内监督，并设置答案级别的边际，使每个文档支持的答案优于其配对的替代答案。在两个数据集和两种学生规模上，EP-OPD恢复了标准OPD反事实准确性损失的54-66%，同时保留了其原始文档准确性增长的80-85%。我们的结果将证据响应确立为与答案准确性并列的训练和评估目标。我们的代码公开可在：https://github.com/RuoranXu/EP-OPD。

articles.title: Towards Self-Evolving Narrative Systems: Real-Time Adaptation and Long-Term Optimization with LLMs
articles.abstract: Traditional interactive narrative systems offer strong authorial control and structural coherence but often restrict player agency. In contrast, LLM-driven narratives enable open-ended generation and greater flexibility, yet frequently suffer from inconsistency and diminished narrative control. To navigate this trade-off, we propose a hybrid narrative framework that dynamically balances pre-authored content with real-time LLM generation via semantic similarity alignment. Additionally, sustaining narrative quality over extended gameplay remains a core challenge in LLM-based storytelling. To address this, we introduce a self-evolving, feedback-driven optimization framework that leverages in-context learning to iteratively refine prompts, eliminating the need for manual prompt engineering. Through a case study and participant-based evaluation, we show that our framework enhances narrative coherence while preserving player agency, effectively aligning generated content with both authorial intent and evolving player behavior.
