articles.titleCn: 面向自我进化的叙事系统：利用大型语言模型实现实时适应与长期优化
articles.abstractCn: 传统的交互式叙事系统提供了强大的作者控制和结构一致性，但往往限制了玩家的自主性。相比之下，由大型语言模型驱动的叙事能够实现开放式生成和更高的灵活性，但常常存在不一致性和叙事控制力减弱的问题。为了应对这一权衡，我们提出了一种混合叙事框架，通过语义相似度对齐动态平衡预创作内容和实时大型语言模型生成。此外，在基于大型语言模型的叙事中，持续在长时间游戏过程中保持叙事质量仍然是一个核心挑战。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了一种自我进化、反馈驱动的优化框架，该框架利用情境学习来迭代优化提示，无需人工提示工程。通过案例研究和基于参与者的评估，我们证明了我们的框架增强了叙事连贯性，同时保留了玩家的自主性，有效地使生成内容与作者意图和不断变化的玩家行为保持一致。

articles.title: Tracing How Language Models Integrate Temporal Anchors into Factual Recall
articles.abstract: Factual recall in language models is typically framed as retrieving a factual association: a subject--relation pair maps to a single object. However, many facts are context-dependent: the same pair maps to different objects depending on a condition such as time. We introduce anchored factual recall, in which the model receives an explicit conditioning expression, an anchor, and must select the object valid under it. This raises questions that single-object recall does not: where the anchor enters the computation, what it changes, and how that change selects the answer. Focusing on temporal anchors, we answer them with causal interventions on four open-weight models on English prompts and identify two routes. In a subject-mediated route, the anchor resolves the final subject-token representation to the queried year, and the relation redistributes the readout of this state across attention heads. In a direct route] the final position attends to the anchor, and upper-layer MLPs turn this signal into a preference for the time-appropriate object. The two routes are parallel channels: their contributions add up, most queries use both, and their balance depends on the query, e.g., on the relation, consistently across models. This reframes mechanistic accounts of factual recall from retrieving a single stored object to selecting among context-dependent alternatives.
articles.titleCn: 追踪语言模型如何将时间锚点整合到事实性回忆中
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型中的事实性召回通常被定义为检索一个事实关联：一个主语-关系对映射到一个单一对象。然而，许多事实是依赖于上下文的：同一个对在不同条件下（如时间）会映射到不同的对象。我们引入了锚定事实性召回，其中模型接收一个明确的条件表达式，即锚点，并必须选择在锚点下有效的对象。这提出了单对象召回所没有的问题：锚点如何进入计算过程、它改变了什么以及这种改变如何选择答案。聚焦于时间锚点，我们通过在四个英语提示的开放权重模型上进行因果干预来回答这些问题，并确定了两种路径。在主语中介路径中，锚点将最终的主语标记表示解析到查询年份，而关系则将这种状态的读数重新分配到注意力头中。在直接路径中，最终位置关注锚点，上层MLP将这个信号转化为对时间恰当对象的选择偏好。这两种路径是并行通道：它们的贡献相加，大多数查询同时使用两者，它们的平衡取决于查询，例如取决于关系，并且在所有模型中始终如一。这重新定义了事实性召回的机制解释，从检索单个存储对象转变为在依赖于上下文的替代方案中进行选择。

articles.title: TAC-CoT: Tool-Empowered Implicit Chain-of-Thought via Interleaving Explicit Tokens
articles.abstract: LLM-based agentic systems are increasingly combined with CoT reasoning to solve tasks that require accurate reasoning, external knowledge, and multi-step deliberation. Yet, explicit CoT incurs substantial generation overhead, while implicit CoT, which replaces textual rationales with compact continuous tokens, does not naturally support the explicit communication interface required for agentic tool-use. We propose TAC-CoT, a tool-empowered adaptive implicit CoT framework that replaces explicit reasoning traces with compact latent reasoning segments while retaining textual tokens only for tool calls, observations, and final answers. This interleaved design enables agentic tool-use without verbalizing every intermediate reasoning step. Experiments on agentic math and QA benchmarks show that TAC-CoT improves accuracy by up to 8.8 points while reducing model forward passes by up to 6.8x. Furthermore, analyses show that TAC-CoT improves tool-use quality in both single- and multi-tool settings.
articles.titleCn: TAC-CoT：通过交错显式标记的工具赋能隐式思维链
articles.abstractCn: 基于LLM的代理系统正越来越多地与思维链（CoT）推理相结合，以解决需要准确推理、外部知识和多步深思熟虑的任务。然而，显式思维链会产生显著的生成开销，而隐式思维链通过将文本推理替换为紧凑的连续标记，并不自然地支持代理工具使用所需的显式通信接口。我们提出了TAC-CoT，这是一个工具赋能的自适应隐式思维链框架，它用紧凑的潜在推理片段替换显式推理轨迹，同时仅保留文本标记用于工具调用、观察和最终答案。这种交错设计使得代理工具使用无需表述每个中间推理步骤。在代理数学和问答基准测试上的实验表明，TAC-CoT将准确率提高了高达8.8个百分点，同时将模型前向传递次数减少了高达6.8倍。此外，分析表明，TAC-CoT在单工具和多工具设置中均提高了工具使用质量。

articles.title: Don't Guess, Ask Wisely: Benchmarking and Training Proactive Elicitation in Open-Domain LLM Conversations
articles.abstract: When user queries are incomplete, large language models should ask targeted questions before committing to an answer, a capability we call proactive elicitation, yet evaluation on real user-assistant queries across seven LLMs (8B to frontier) shows that fewer than 11% of underspecified queries trigger a follow-up question. To benchmark and train this capability, we introduce VagueBench, where each seed query is annotated with structured intent and detail units then degraded into intent-vague and fully-vague variants via controlled removal of linguistic cues, yielding known hidden information sets for evaluating both when and what to ask. We propose DialogGRPO, an offline reinforcement learning method that organizes multi-turn elicitation as a dialogue-state directed acyclic graph, where candidate questions at each node receive dense turn-level rewards combining immediate information gain with lookahead value through group-relative comparison, enabling fine-grained credit assignment without runtime simulation. DialogGRPO elicits missing information on over 88% of vague queries with substantial gains in both recovery efficiency and answer coverage, without over-asking on complete queries, outperforms prompting and test-time-scaling baselines, and generalizes zero-shot to MultiWOZ 2.4 and AmbigQA.
articles.titleCn: 不要猜测，明智提问：开放域LLM对话中主动探询的基准测试与训练
articles.abstractCn: 当用户查询不完整时，大型语言模型应在给出答案前提出有针对性的问题，我们称之为主动探询能力。然而，在七个大型语言模型（8B到前沿模型）的真实用户-助手查询上的评估显示，不到11%的不完整查询会触发后续问题。为了基准测试和训练这一能力，我们引入了VagueBench，其中每个种子查询都标注了结构化意图和细节单元，并通过受控移除语言线索将其降级为意图模糊和完全模糊的变体，从而生成已知隐藏信息集，用于评估何时以及询问什么。我们提出了DialogGRPO，这是一种离线强化学习方法，将多轮探询组织为对话状态有向无环图，其中每个节点的候选问题通过组内相对比较获得结合即时信息增益和前瞻价值的密集回合级奖励，从而实现细粒度的归因分配，无需运行时模拟。DialogGRPO在88%以上的模糊查询中探询缺失信息，显著提升了恢复效率和答案覆盖率，且不会对完整查询过度提问，优于提示和测试时缩放基线，并能零样本泛化到MultiWOZ 2.4和AmbigQA。

articles.title: Quantizing Recurrent Language Models Is Easier Than You Think
articles.abstract: Linear recurrences are becoming an increasingly common building block in large language models, replacing the growing KV cache of softmax attention with a fixed-size recurrent state that enables efficient decoding. However, the quantization stack has largely been developed around softmax Transformers, whose numerical properties and inference state differ from those of recurrent models. Our goal is to understand these differences and study the design space of quantization methods for recurrent models. In our analysis, we differentiate between two targets. First, extra-state quantization concerns weights and activations outside the recurrent state, whose distributions are shaped indirectly by the sequence mixer during training. In controlled 1.3B parameter models, we find that decayed recurrences develop weaker residual outlier channels than softmax attention and are therefore easier to quantize without incoherence processing. Second, intra-state quantization concerns the recurrent state itself during decode, where repeated updates create a different numerical problem from KV cache quantization. We instantiate our findings as LoReS, a state quantization pipeline combining value-axis scale grouping to match output channel magnitude, decay-based mixed-precision to protect slowly decaying heads or channels, and stochastic rounding to limit error accumulation under repeated requantization. Across Qwen-3.5 9B, Nemotron-H 8B, and Kimi-Linear 48B-A3B, LoReS supports robust 8-bit state quantization and lower effective precision on shorter decode horizons. We implement LoReS in vLLM and demonstrate end-to-end decode speedups.
articles.titleCn: 量化循环语言模型比你想象的要简单
articles.abstractCn: 线性递归正逐渐成为大型语言模型中日益常见的构建模块，用固定大小的递归状态取代了softmax注意力机制不断增长的KV缓存，从而实现高效的解码。然而，量化栈主要围绕softmax Transformer开发，其数值特性和推理状态与递归模型存在差异。我们的目标是理解这些差异，并研究递归模型量化方法的设计空间。在我们的分析中，我们区分了两个目标。首先，额外状态量化涉及递归状态之外的权重和激活，其分布间接受到序列混合器在训练过程中的影响。在受控的1.3B参数模型中，我们发现衰减递归产生的残差异常通道比softmax注意力弱，因此更容易在不进行非一致性处理的情况下进行量化。其次，状态内量化涉及解码时的递归状态本身，重复更新创造了与KV缓存量化不同的数值问题。我们将我们的发现实例化为LoReS，这是一个结合值轴尺度分组以匹配输出通道幅度、基于衰减的混合精度保护缓慢衰减的头部或通道，以及随机舍入以限制重复量化下的误差累积的状态量化流程。在Qwen-3.5 9B、Nemotron-H 8B和Kimi-Linear 48B-A3B上，LoReS支持鲁棒的8位状态量化和较短的解码视距上的较低有效精度。我们在vLLM中实现了LoReS，并展示了端到端的解码加速。

articles.title: Self-Evolving Agentic Workflows via Semantic Decomposition of Complex Tasks
articles.abstract: Agentic workflows organize complex tasks into reusable procedures. However, invoking an LLM at every step incurs repeated inference costs and delays. We propose a framework for self-evolving agentic workflows through semantic task decomposition. Each subtask has explicit applicability conditions and a procedure that executes code or invokes a model as needed. An agent uses execution feedback to refine the decomposition and update these procedures. Experiments in the GLEE competition show the framework on bargaining, negotiation and persuasion. Most observed final-decision procedures are implemented in code. Code is available at https://github.com/Applied-Machine-Learning-Lab/NeurIPS2026_SeaFlow.
articles.comment: Accepted as a Spotlight at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Interpreting Agent Behavior (IAB), GLEE Competition Track; 1st place in the GLEE competition. 21 pages
articles.titleCn: 基于复杂任务语义分解的自演化代理工作流
articles.abstractCn: 智能体工作流将复杂任务组织成可重用的流程。然而，每一步都调用大型语言模型会导致重复的推理成本和延迟。我们提出了一种通过语义任务分解实现自我进化的智能体工作流框架。每个子任务都有明确的应用条件和一个根据需要执行代码或调用模型的流程。智能体利用执行反馈来优化分解并更新这些流程。在GLEE竞赛中的实验展示了该框架在谈判、协商和说服中的应用。观察到的多数最终决策流程都是通过代码实现的。代码可在https://github.com/Applied-Machine-Learning-Lab/NeurIPS2026_SeaFlow获取。

articles.title: LegoEnv: Self-Evolving Agentic Environments via Modular Recombination
articles.abstract: LLM agents learn by interacting with environments, yet existing environments are designed for specific tasks and fail to generalize to new ones. Recent methods automate environment construction with LLMs. However, they generate each environment from scratch, neither reusing parts shared across environments nor carrying a fix from one environment to the rest. To address this, we propose a new paradigm of evolving environment atoms, which composes environments from reusable atoms (intent, rule, data and server) and evolves the atoms when an environment fails to give reliable feedback (e.g., an application lacks a tool the task requires). To instantiate this paradigm, we introduce LegoEnv, which builds 5,465 verified environments over 223 applications, and one round of evolution raises the share of solvable environments from 71.6% to 88.3%. On AutomationBench, SFT on these environments lifts Qwen3.6-27B from 16.0% to 32.0%, and RL with their verifiers lifts Qwen3.8-27B from 37.6% to 40.3%. Further analyses show steady gains with corpus size, transfer to unseen applications, and failures concentrated in a few shared root causes.
articles.titleCn: LegoEnv：通过模块化重组实现自我进化的智能体环境
articles.abstractCn: LLM代理通过与环境交互来学习，但现有的环境是为特定任务设计的，无法泛化到新任务。最近的方法使用LLM自动构建环境，但它们从零开始生成每个环境，既不重用跨环境共享的部分，也不将一个环境的改进传递给其他环境。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一个进化环境原子的新范式，该范式通过可重用的原子（意图、规则、数据和服务器）组合环境，并在环境无法提供可靠反馈时（例如，应用程序缺少任务所需的工具）进化这些原子。为实例化这一范式，我们引入了LegoEnv，该工具在223个应用程序上构建了5,465个经过验证的环境，一轮进化将可解决环境的比例从71.6%提高到88.3%。在AutomationBench上，针对这些环境进行的SFT将Qwen3.6-27B的性能从16.0%提升至32.0%，而使用它们的验证器进行的RL将Qwen3.8-27B的性能从37.6%提升至40.3%。进一步分析表明，随着语料库规模的增加、迁移到未见过的应用程序以及失败集中在少数几个共享的根本原因上，性能稳步提升。

articles.title: The Scope Grammar of Natural-Language Rules: Counting and Enumerating Readings modulo Logical Equivalence
articles.abstract: A rule written for people fixes its atomic conditions and connectives but leaves open how the connectives are bracketed, and each bracketing is a different logical reading that an autoformalizer must resolve or expose. We study the scope grammar, a deliberately ambiguous context-free grammar whose derivation trees are the readings of a connective skeleton and whose quotient by logical equivalence is what matters downstream. A skeleton with $k$ binary connectives has $C_k$ derivation trees, the $k$-th Catalan number, but far fewer logically distinct readings. For the positive, repetition-free fragment we make the gap exact: through the uniqueness of the read-once normal form we characterize the realizable normal forms by lowest common ancestors and count them with a two-label recurrence over the operator word, verified against exhaustive enumeration up to eleven atoms. The count is invariant under reversal and $\wedge/\vee$ duality; a skeleton is ambiguous if and only if it uses both $\wedge$ and $\vee$, a one-pass test; and the number of classes is at least $2^{\lfloor n/3\rfloor}$. Up to fifteen atoms the alternating pattern is the worst case; its count has a cubic generating function, is the 3-Schröder sequence (OEIS A137842), and grows with base $\varphi^{5/2}\approx3.330$, below the Catalan base 4. We reduce maximality to an inequality on increments, verified to sixteen atoms, and explain why local exchange arguments cannot prove it. We also treat negation, exceptions, and background axioms, where normal-form uniqueness still decides equivalence but counting is open.
articles.titleCn: 自然语言规则的范畴语法：基于逻辑等价性的读数计数与列举
articles.abstractCn: 为人类编写规则会固定其原子条件和连接词，但保留连接词的括号方式，而每种括号方式都代表一种不同的逻辑解读，自动形式化器必须解决或揭示这些解读。我们研究范围文法，这是一种故意模糊的非确定性文法，其推导树是连接词骨架的解读，而逻辑等价下的商集才是下游关注点。一个包含k个二元连接词的骨架有Ck个推导树，即第k个 Catalan 数，但逻辑上不同的解读却少得多。对于正则、无重复片段，我们使差距精确化：通过唯一的一次读取规范形式，我们通过最低公共祖先来表征可实现规范形式，并使用运算符词的两标签递推关系来计数，并通过对最多11个原子的穷举枚举进行验证。计数在反转和 ∧/∨ 对偶下保持不变；一个骨架是模糊的当且仅当它同时使用 ∧ 和 ∨，这是一种单次测试；并且类别数至少为 2^⌊n/3⌋。在最多15个原子的情况下，交替模式是最坏情况；其计数具有三次生成函数，是 3-Schröder 序列（OEIS A137842），并以 φ^(5/2)≈3.330 为基数增长，低于 Catalan 基数4。我们将最大性简化为一个增量不等式，并验证到16个原子，并解释为什么局部交换论证不能证明它。我们还处理了否定、例外和背景公理，其中规范形式的唯一性仍然决定等价，但计数是开放的。

articles.title: Shared relations, specific choices: conditional sensitivity and competing pathways in language models
articles.abstract: How does a relational representation shared across queries drive a query-specific choice? Controlled entity-binding experiments with GPT-2 Small, Qwen2.5-1.5B and Llama-3.2-1B reveal a low-dimensional relational background that is predominantly shared across query roles and transfers to new names. Same-domain interactions persist when another attribute domain is queried. After removing this component, restoring independently trained relation directions brings output contrasts closer to their original values than sign-reversed or equal-norm random controls in all three models. Yet a transferable relational representation need not have a transferable functional sign. In Qwen2.5, fixing model weights, the training-mean relation vector and edit dose yields opposite selection effects across binary and lexical-mapping prompts with different answer vocabularies. A factorial contrast of downstream sensitivities across attribute-query combinations determines the shared direction's local signed selection gain. In a separate eight-condition protocol, mean local gain is positive in Qwen2.5 and negative in Llama3.2. Late-component clamps resolve opposing pathway contributions: in Llama3.2, negative transmission through selected attention-only paths is partially offset by positive transmission through paths traversing both selected attention and MLP sets. Source-coordinate analyses establish distributed factor coverage, hidden-receiver readouts reveal layout-dependent combination, and instance-geometry interventions separate response direction from amplitude. These findings show how conditional sensitivity and competing pathways give shared relational structure its effect on specific choices.
articles.titleCn: 共享关系，具体选择：语言模型中的条件敏感性和竞争路径
articles.abstractCn: 跨查询共享的关系表示如何驱动特定查询的选择？对GPT-2 Small、Qwen2.5-1.5B和Llama-3.2-1B进行的受控实体绑定实验揭示了一种低维关系背景，这种背景主要在查询角色间共享，并能迁移到新名称。当查询另一个属性域时，同域交互仍然存在。移除该组件后，恢复独立训练的关系方向使得所有三个模型中的输出对比更接近原始值，而非符号反转或等范数随机控制。然而，可迁移的关系表示不必具有可迁移的功能性符号。在Qwen2.5中，固定模型权重时，训练均值关系向量和编辑剂量在具有不同答案词汇表的二元和词汇映射提示中产生相反的选择效应。属性查询组合的下游敏感性因子对比确定了共享方向的局部符号选择增益。在一个包含八种条件的独立协议中，Qwen2.5的平均局部增益为正，Llama3.2为负。晚期组件夹持解决了相反路径贡献：在Llama3.2中，通过仅选定的注意力路径的负传输部分被通过同时穿越选定注意力和MLP集的路径的正传输所抵消。源坐标分析确立了分布式因子覆盖，隐藏接收器读数揭示了布局相关的组合，实例几何干预将响应方向与幅度分离。这些发现展示了条件敏感性和竞争路径如何赋予共享关系结构对特定选择的影响。

articles.title: Rubric-Based Assessment of Student Reports Using Small Language Models
articles.abstract: Language models can analyze and assess student texts using predefined rubrics and deliver structured feedback, reducing instructors' workload. However, existing solutions often rely on external services that are resource-intensive, costly, and raise privacy concerns, making them unsuitable for constrained environments. This study evaluates an automated assessment pipeline with three key aims: design for low-resource environments, privacy, and focus on a novel context in cybersecurity education. The pipeline integrates lightweight language models for textual evaluation and a vision-language model for image interpretation. Responses from 105 students were collected over two semesters of an undergraduate course during a cybersecurity exercise on incident response. Results across different hardware configurations show that small models in low-resource environments can achieve up to 97% accuracy in text-only and up to 94% in rich-text assessments. This rivals or even outperforms a large model while adding the benefits of locally hosted assessment. Our solution can help educators and practitioners who need grading assistance without replacing human oversight, especially in environments where cloud-based solutions may be impractical. This study contributes an open-source, locally deployable AI-assisted scoring pipeline that runs on affordable hardware and can be extended to various types of student reports in computing education. As a result, it makes automated assessment accessible to a broad range of educators and institutions.

articles.titleCn: 基于评分标准的、使用小型语言模型的、学生报告的评估
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型能够利用预定义的评分标准分析并评估学生文本，并提供结构化的反馈，从而减轻教师的工作量。然而，现有的解决方案通常依赖外部服务，这些服务资源密集、成本高昂，并引发隐私问题，因此不适合受限环境。本研究评估了一个自动化评估流程，其核心目标为：设计适用于低资源环境、注重隐私保护，并聚焦于网络安全教育这一新场景。该流程集成了轻量级语言模型用于文本评估，以及视觉语言模型用于图像解读。在为期两个学期的本科课程网络安全演练中，收集了105名学生的反馈。在不同硬件配置下的结果表明，在低资源环境中，小型模型在纯文本评估中可达到高达97%的准确率，在富文本评估中可达到高达94%的准确率。这甚至可以与大型模型相媲美，甚至超越其性能，同时还能享受本地部署评估的好处。我们的解决方案能够帮助需要评分辅助的教育工作者和实践者，同时不取代人工监督，特别是在云解决方案可能不切实际的环境中。本研究贡献了一个开源的、可本地部署的AI辅助评分流程，该流程可在经济实惠的硬件上运行，并可扩展到计算教育中的各种类型的学生报告。因此，它使自动化评估变得更加普及，惠及更广泛的教育工作者和机构。

articles.title: MemRole: From Memories to Decisions for Long-Horizon Reasoning in Role-Playing Agents
articles.abstract: LLM-based role-playing agents are fluent at imitating a character's style, yet struggle to make role-consistent decisions over long narrative horizons. Such decisions are shaped by experiences spanning many prior scenes, which are often partial and may point in different directions. Existing methods inject cross-scene memories as context, but do not reason about how past events shape a character's current motivations and behavior. We propose MemRole, a framework that makes this memory-to-decision process explicit. It introduces Long-Horizon Memory Thinking (LHMT), a reasoning schema that decomposes hidden reasoning into context understanding, memory activation, and response strategy planning, trained on a novel-derived dataset whose character-grounded, timeline-constrained memory pools limit each character to what it could plausibly know at the current narrative point. Beyond supervised fine-tuning, we propose Self-Refining On-Policy Self-Distillation (SR-OPSD): the model critiques its own rollouts against the reference under a data-driven rubric, and a critique-conditioned teacher view of the same model distills token-level guidance back into the policy. MemRole-32B improves over its backbone by 15.2 points on memory-grounded role-playing, performs on par with frontier LLMs such as GPT-5.4, and achieves the best character-motivation recognition accuracy on CroSS-MR.
articles.titleCn: MemRole：角色扮演智能体中长时程推理从记忆到决策
articles.abstractCn: 基于LLM的角色扮演代理在模仿角色风格方面非常流畅，但在长期叙事视野中做出与角色一致的决定方面却面临困难。这类决定受到跨越许多先前场景的体验的影响，这些体验通常是部分的，并且可能指向不同的方向。现有方法将跨场景记忆作为上下文注入，但并未推理过去事件如何塑造角色当前的动机和行为。我们提出了MemRole，这是一个使记忆到决策过程显式的框架。它引入了长期记忆思考（LHMT），这是一种推理模式，将隐藏的推理分解为上下文理解、记忆激活和响应策略规划，并在一个新颖衍生的数据集上进行训练，该数据集的角色基础、时间线限制的记忆池将每个角色的知识限制在当前叙事点可能合理知道的内容。除了监督微调之外，我们还提出了自我完善在线策略自我蒸馏（SR-OPSD）：模型在数据驱动的标准下对其自己的滚动进行批判，并且同一模型的批判条件化教师视图将标记级指导蒸馏回策略。MemRole-32B在基于记忆的角色扮演方面比其骨干模型提高了15.2分，表现与前沿LLM（如GPT-5.4）相当，并在CroSS-MR上实现了最佳角色动机识别准确率。

articles.title: A Bounded Evaluation Protocol for Representational Systematicity
articles.abstract: Multiple studies have shown that neural networks can be behaviorally systematic, producing correct outputs for novel combinations of familiar parts. Whether they are also representationally systematic, that is, whether they represent these parts and their roles and use them to produce the outputs, remains hard to test, because each kind of evidence can mislead on its own: correct outputs can come from shortcuts, a decodable signal need not be used, an intervention can act through unintended pathways, and a failed search does not show absence. We propose a bounded evaluation protocol for representational systematicity (Bounded-RS): for an explanation that attributes a systematic behavior to a declared representation, it tests on a matched behavioral contrast whether that representation is recoverable and whether it is causally used, checks the validity of this evidence, and assigns the explanation one of four bounded states, Unsupported, Present-only, Causal-use, or Undetermined, through control-calibrated scores, gates, and stop rules. On a semantic-parsing testbed of 96 matched sets that we release, the tested role-filler Binding explanation of fine-tuned T5 models is Causal-use and the distributed Geometry explanation is Unsupported within its declared search space, verdicts that hold across calibration-compatible parameter configurations, training seeds, and T5-base. On 41 cases with known causal status, full adjudication licenses a false Causal-use in 1 of 34 noncausal cases, against 13 when recoverability is taken as use, without missing any causal case. Bounded-RS thus turns the question of representational systematicity, debated since Fodor and Pylyshyn, into comparable and falsifiable verdicts on declared explanations, each reported with the evidence pattern that licenses it and, for a negative, the search space that bounds it.

articles.titleCn: 一个表示系统性有界评估协议
articles.abstractCn: 多项研究表明，神经网络在行为上具有系统性，能够对熟悉部分的全新组合产生正确输出。然而，它们是否也具有表示上的系统性，即是否能够表示这些部分及其作用并利用它们来产生输出，仍然难以检验，因为每种证据都可能单独误导：正确输出可能来自捷径，可解码的信号不一定被使用，干预可能通过非预期的途径起作用，而失败的搜索也不表明不存在因果关系。我们提出了一种表示系统性有界评估协议（Bounded-RS）：对于将系统性行为归因于声明表示的解释，它在匹配的行为对比上检验该表示是否可恢复以及是否被因果使用，检查证据的有效性，并通过控制校准的分数、门控和停止规则，将解释分配为四种有界状态之一：不受支持、仅存在、因果使用或未确定。在一个包含96组匹配集的语义解析测试平台上，我们测试的微调T5模型的role-filler绑定解释为因果使用，而分布式几何解释在其声明的搜索空间内不受支持，这些裁决在不同的校准兼容参数配置、训练种子和T5-base下均成立。在41个已知因果状态的案例中，全面裁决允许在34个非因果案例中的1个产生错误的因果使用，而在将可恢复性视为使用的情况下，只有13个案例产生错误因果使用，且未遗漏任何因果案例。因此，Bounded-RS将自Fodor和Pylyshyn以来备受争议的表示系统性问题，转化为对声明解释的可比且可证伪的裁决，每种裁决都附有授权它的证据模式，对于负面结果，则附有界定其搜索空间。

articles.title: Evolving Memory, Learning to Meta-Control: Test-Time Adaptation for Experience-augmented LLM Agents
articles.abstract: Self-evolving agents accumulate experience from task streams, but existing frameworks typically rely on fixed pipelines to retrieve and utilize this experience, neglecting when and how to deploy it. We introduce Online Meta-Control of Experience (OMCE), a framework that updates experience memory and learns a meta-control policy from task feedback during test-time adaptation. OMCE employs a lightweight contextual-bandit meta-controller that uses compact retrieval signals to select among four cognitive actions: DIRECT, EPISODE, GUIDE, and DISTILL. This routing mechanism operationalizes three coupled decisions: whether to invoke experience, which memory format to utilize, and when to consolidate new guidance. OMCE evolves online, leveraging task feedback to update the memory bank and refine the routing policy via contextual bandit updates. Experiments on four online adaptation benchmarks across four backbones show that OMCE improves first-attempt success by up to 20.5 percentage points over the strongest compared baseline, while reducing per-task token use by a factor of 5.7 to 62.5 relative to ACE with GPT-5.2. Controlled ablations further support the benefits of learned routing and continued routing policy adaptation.

articles.titleCn: 进化记忆，元控制学习：经验增强型LLM智能体的测试时自适应
articles.abstractCn: 自进化智能体从任务流中积累经验，但现有框架通常依赖固定流程来检索和利用这些经验，忽略了何时以及如何部署它们。我们引入了经验在线元控制（OMCE）框架，该框架在测试时适应期间从任务反馈中更新经验记忆并学习元控制策略。OMCE采用轻量级上下文 bandit 元控制器，使用紧凑的检索信号从四个认知动作中选择：直接（DIRECT）、片段（EPISODE）、指导（GUIDE）和蒸馏（DISTILL）。这种路由机制实现了三个耦合决策：是否调用经验、使用哪种记忆格式以及何时整合新指导。OMCE在线进化，利用任务反馈更新记忆库，并通过上下文 bandit 更新来优化路由策略。在四个在线适应基准测试中，使用四种主干网络进行实验表明，与最强的基线相比，OMCE将首次尝试成功率提高了高达20.5个百分点，同时相对于使用GPT-5.2的ACE，每任务token使用量减少了5.7倍至62.5倍。受控消融实验进一步证实了学习路由和持续路由策略适应的好处。

articles.title: Less but Sufficient: Relation Knowledge Selects Compact Knowledge-Graph Contexts, and What External Checks Can and Cannot Catch
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) read knowledge-graph facts ranked by relevance, leaving open whether they suffice or conflict. Our checks use relation knowledge, written by hand or learned from training questions labelled with their relation paths. It selects a compact context of facts yielding an answer, and derives it; a derivability check tests whether an answer follows, a consistency check whether facts conflict, and a validation-chosen routing gate decides where the derived answer replaces the LLM's. Seven open LLMs read the compact context better in exact match than relevance-ranked facts; on ComplexWebQuestions (CWQ) they match SubgraphRAG's facts at a quarter of the prompt tokens, and stronger LLMs read SubgraphRAG's better. Where the routing gate passes, ours leads SubgraphRAG's in exact match in all 53 LLM, benchmark and prompt settings. A precision gate, returning the derived answer only when the check passes with exactly one derived entity, answered 18 and 5 percent of held-out WebQSP and CWQ questions in a pre-specified test, right for 90 and 96 percent. The consistency check judges facts by path evidence only where another path joins their entities, true of 2.5 percent of named-entity facts in our compact WebQSP and CWQ contexts.
articles.titleCn: 少即是多：关系知识选择紧凑知识图谱上下文，以及外部检查能做什么和不能做什么
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）读取按相关性排序的知识图谱事实，这引发了它们是否足够或存在冲突的问题。我们的检查使用关系知识，这些知识可以是手工编写或从带有关系路径标签的训练问题中学习得到。它选择一个包含事实的紧凑上下文以生成答案，并推导出该答案；一个可推导性检查测试答案是否有效，一个一致性检查测试事实是否存在冲突，而一个由验证选择的路由门决定推导出的答案将替换LLM的位置。七种开源LLM在精确匹配方面比按相关性排序的事实更能更好地读取紧凑上下文；在ComplexWebQuestions（CWQ）数据集上，它们在提示令牌的四分之一数量下匹配SubgraphRAG的事实，而更强的LLM能更好地读取SubgraphRAG。在路由门通过的情况下，我们的方法在所有53种LLM、基准和提示设置中，在精确匹配方面均优于SubgraphRAG。一个精确门，仅在检查以恰好一个推导实体通过时才返回推导出的答案，在预定义测试中回答了18%和5%的保留WebQSP和CWQ问题，正确率分别为90%和96%。一致性检查仅通过路径证据判断事实，当另一条路径连接它们的实体时，这在我们的紧凑WebQSP和CWQ上下文中的命名实体事实中占2.5%。

articles.title: MAC-Bench: Benchmarking Multi-Agent Collaboration via Interconnected Tasks
articles.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS) tackle challenging tasks by dividing work among agents and coordinating their contributions toward shared objectives. Evaluating these systems therefore requires benchmarks that assess not only task-solving performance but also the ability to handle interdependent work. However, existing benchmarks often emphasize task difficulty without substantial collaboration requirements or evaluate only a limited range of predefined collaboration patterns. In this paper, we introduce MAC-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating multi-agent collaboration through interconnected tasks. Rather than imposing predefined agent roles or communication protocols, MAC-Bench embeds collaboration requirements directly into task dependencies and shared-resource constraints. Specifically, we mine reusable collaboration structures from selected benchmark tasks at two levels. Local collaboration patterns capture recurring interactions among subtasks, while global task structures characterize how these interactions contribute to complete workflows. Through coarse-to-fine composition, these structures are recombined into task graphs combining different collaboration requirements. Tasks are instantiated in executable environments with automated verification of partial progress and complete task resolution.
articles.titleCn: MAC-Bench：通过互联任务进行多智能体协作基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统（MAS）通过分配工作给智能体并协调它们对共同目标的贡献来应对具有挑战性的任务。因此，评估这些系统需要能够不仅评估任务解决性能，还要评估处理相互依存工作的能力的基准。然而，现有的基准往往强调任务难度，而缺乏实质性的协作要求，或者只评估有限范围内的预定义协作模式。在本文中，我们介绍了MAC-Bench，这是一个通过相互关联的任务评估多智能体协作的综合性基准。MAC-Bench不是强加预定义的智能体角色或通信协议，而是将协作要求直接嵌入任务依赖关系和共享资源约束中。具体来说，我们从选定的基准任务中在两个层次上挖掘可重用的协作结构。局部协作模式捕获子任务之间反复出现的交互，而全局任务结构则描述这些交互如何促成完整的工作流程。通过由粗到细的组合，这些结构被重新组合成结合不同协作要求的任务图。任务在可执行环境中实例化，并自动验证部分进度和完整任务解决。

articles.title: EarlySelectKV: Anticipatory KV Selection via Cross-Layer Query Proxies
articles.abstract: Query-conditioned sparse KV selection reduces long-context inference cost by attending to a subset of historical KV entries at each decoding step. Existing selectors must wait for the target-layer query before scoring candidates and generating indices, placing routing on the immediate pre-attention path. We introduce EarlySelectKV, a training-free transformation that uses proxy queries from earlier hidden states to precompute selected KV indices while retaining the real target-layer query for final attention. Tests with RocketKV, Quest, and Loki show no consistent pattern of quality degradation across the evaluated settings. In the primary RocketKV evaluation, ES-RocketKV differs by +0.018 points on LongBench, approximately -0.01 points on RULER, and +0.25 percentage points on representative NIAH/Passkey settings. In a TensorRT-LLM deployment with CPU-offloaded routing, ES-RocketKV improves end-to-end output throughput by up to 12.4% and reduces GPU-resident memory by 11.1% of the combined KV/K-summary pool. This makes routing timing an explicit optimization target alongside KV subset selection in sparse long-context decoding. Code is available at https://github.com/sea-with-sakura/EarlySelectKV.
articles.titleCn: EarlySelectKV：通过跨层查询代理的预期键值对选择
articles.abstractCn: 查询条件稀疏KV选择通过在每次解码步骤中关注历史KV条目的子集来降低长上下文推理成本。现有选择器必须在目标层查询到达后才能对候选进行评分并生成索引，将路由放在立即的预注意力路径上。我们引入了EarlySelectKV，这是一种无需训练的转换，它使用早期隐藏状态的代理查询来预计算选定的KV索引，同时保留真实的最终目标层查询以进行最终注意力。RocketKV、Quest和Loki的测试表明，在评估的设置中未观察到一致的质量下降模式。在主要的RocketKV评估中，ES-RocketKV在LongBench上得分提高0.018分，在RULER上得分降低约0.01分，在代表性的NIAH/Passkey设置上提高0.25个百分点。在带有CPU卸载路由的TensorRT-LLM部署中，ES-RocketKV将端到端输出吞吐量提高高达12.4%，并将GPU驻留内存减少到组合的KV/摘要池的11.1%。这使得路由时间成为稀疏长上下文解码中与KV子集选择并列的显式优化目标。代码可在https://github.com/sea-with-sakura/EarlySelectKV获取。

articles.title: CST: Lightweight Risk Triage with Source-Grounded Evidence for Web Discussions
articles.abstract: Web communities rely on moderators to catch harmful messages such as insults, hate speech, and scams, but no one can read every message. Existing tools give each message a risk score, which tells moderators where to look but not what to read or how to check it. Yet meaning depends on context: the same reply, "I agree.", can support or oppose removing someone from a group. Moderators therefore need source-grounded evidence, not just scores: a few key messages kept with their original wording and replies. We present CST, a lightweight triage pipeline that first decides where to look, then what to show. It scores risk by pairing character patterns, which capture exact wording, with sentence meaning from a fixed multilingual model, so it handles several languages and runs on an ordinary CPU. It then groups related messages and picks from each group in turn, so a small reading budget covers different parts of a discussion, and links every pick back to the original thread. Across six tasks from five datasets in several languages, CST ranks harmful messages more accurately than a fully fine-tuned multilingual model and, under the same budget, finds more of them than reading by score alone. In a user study, reviewers needed at least 27% less time with CST's grouped evidence while keeping decision accuracy above 94%. CST turns risk scores into evidence that moderators can read quickly and check in context. Code and dataset reconstruction resources will be released at https://github.com/Kirito14IT/CST-MIL.
articles.titleCn: 基于源代码证据的轻量级风险分类器用于网络讨论
articles.abstractCn: 网络社区依赖版主来识别有害信息，如侮辱、仇恨言论和诈骗，但无人能阅读每条信息。现有工具为每条信息打风险分，这能指导版主关注何处，却不能告知其阅读内容或如何核查。然而，意义取决于语境：同样的回复“我同意”，可能支持或反对将某人移出群组。因此，版主需要基于来源的证据，而不仅仅是分数：保留几条关键信息及其原始措辞和回复。我们提出了CST，一个轻量级的分诊管道，它首先决定关注何处，然后展示何种内容。它通过将捕捉精确措辞的字符模式与固定多语言模型的句子意义进行配对来评分风险，因此它支持多种语言并在普通CPU上运行。接着，它将相关信息分组，并依次从每个组中挑选，使得较小的阅读预算能覆盖讨论的不同部分，并将每次挑选链接回原始讨论串。在六项任务、五个数据集、多种语言中，CST比完全微调的多语言模型更准确地排序有害信息，并在相同预算下比仅凭分数阅读发现更多有害信息。在一项用户研究中，评审者使用CST分组证据时，所需时间减少了至少27%，同时决策准确率保持在94%以上。CST将风险分数转化为版主能快速阅读并在语境中核查的证据。代码和数据集重建资源将在https://github.com/Kirito14IT/CST-MIL发布。

articles.title: EEG-HealthLLM: Hierarchical Adaptation of Large Language Models for Unified Heterogeneous EEG Health Assessment
articles.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) provides a non-invasive means for neurological and mental health assessment, yet existing EEG models are typically developed for individual tasks and are difficult to unify across heterogeneous signal configurations and assessment objectives. Large language models (LLMs) offer a common interface for multiple tasks, but adapting heterogeneous EEG signals to a shared LLM raises a key challenge: how to preserve task-specific signal characteristics while enabling effective language-side parameter sharing. To address this problem, we propose EEG-HealthLLM, a unified and parameter-efficient framework for heterogeneous EEG health assessment. We introduce an Asymmetric Hierarchical Adaptation Strategy: task-specific EEG adapters preserve heterogeneous spatio-temporal dynamics, while a unified shared LoRA is injected into the LLM backbone (e.g., Phi-3) to capture shared high-level assessment semantics across tasks. We further establish EEG-HealthBench by reorganizing five existing EEG resources into paradigms covering epileptic seizure detection, major depressive disorder assessment, anxiety risk assessment, depressive symptom risk assessment, and emotional state assessment under a unified subject-independent protocol. Extensive experiments show that EEG-HealthLLM achieves an average balanced accuracy (BAC) of 69.58%, ranking first among the evaluated methods in both average BAC and macro-F1. Compared with independent single-task LoRA adaptation, it improves average BAC from 67.70% to 69.58% while reducing the aggregate language-side adapter footprint by 80.0%. Further analyses reveal task-dependent cross-task interactions and trade-offs, supporting the proposed hierarchical adaptation strategy. The implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/Marui-88/EEG-HealthLLM.
articles.titleCn: EEG-HealthLLM：用于统一异构脑电图健康评估的大语言模型的分层自适应
articles.abstractCn: 脑电图（EEG）为神经学和心理健康评估提供了一种非侵入性手段，然而现有的EEG模型通常是为单个任务开发的，难以在异构信号配置和评估目标之间统一。大型语言模型（LLMs）为多任务提供了通用接口，但将异构EEG信号适配到共享LLM时面临一个关键挑战：如何在保留特定任务信号特征的同时实现有效的语言端参数共享。为解决这一问题，我们提出了EEG-HealthLLM，一个用于异构EEG健康评估的统一且参数高效的框架。我们引入了一种非对称分层适配策略：特定任务的EEG适配器保留了异构时空动态特性，同时将统一的共享LoRA注入LLM主干（例如Phi-3）以捕获跨任务共享的高级评估语义。我们进一步通过重组五个现有的EEG资源，建立了EEG-HealthBench，这些资源被组织成涵盖癫痫发作检测、重度抑郁症评估、焦虑风险评估、抑郁症状风险评估和情绪状态评估的范式，并采用统一的、与受试者无关的协议。大量实验表明，EEG-HealthLLM实现了平均平衡精度（BAC）69.58%，在平均BAC和宏观F1方面均位居评估方法之首。与独立的单任务LoRA适配相比，它将平均BAC从67.70%提升至69.58%，同时将语言端适配器的总占用空间减少了80.0%。进一步分析揭示了任务相关的跨任务交互和权衡，支持所提出的分层适配策略。该实现已在https://github.com/Marui-88/EEG-HealthLLM公开发布。

articles.title: CREDO: Evidence-Conditioned Credit Assignment for Temporal Reasoning Agents
articles.abstract: Temporal Knowledge Graph Question Answering (TKGQA) requires language model agents to retrieve evidence, select relevant facts, and perform multi-step temporal reasoning. However, the trajectory-level outcome signal in GRPO does not explicitly distinguish the quality of intermediate decisions: downstream failures can penalize useful evidence acquisition, while identical rewards in all-failed groups eliminate the relative outcome signal despite differences in intermediate progress. We propose Credit Redistribution with Evidence-Driven Opportunities (CREDO), which uses intermediate evidence to recover local supervision, including in all-failed groups, and determine where outcome supervision acts. CREDO assigns positive stage-level credit through comparisons among rollouts of the same question and uses retained answer overlap as an opportunity proxy to shift part of the outcome-policy weight toward reasoning and answering. The framework preserves terminal rewards and trajectory-level advantages, while redistribution conserves total outcome-policy weight per trajectory. Following the public evaluation protocol of prior work, CREDO raises Overall accuracy from 78.0% to 82.4% and Multiple accuracy from 55.0% to 65.6% on MultiTQ relative to the strongest published baseline in our comparison. On TimelineKGQA, it raises cross-KG accuracy from 30.9% to 36.4% relative to our reproduced baseline via direct transfer to ICEWS Actor under matched training and evaluation settings.
articles.titleCn: 信念：证据条件信用分配，用于时间推理代理
articles.abstractCn: 时序知识图谱问答（TKGQA）需要语言模型代理检索证据、选择相关事实并执行多步时序推理。然而，在GRPO中，轨迹级别的结果信号并未明确区分中间决策的质量：下游的失败会惩罚有用证据的获取，而所有失败组中的相同奖励则消除了相对结果信号，尽管中间进度存在差异。我们提出了基于证据驱动的机遇信用再分配（CREDO），该方案利用中间证据恢复局部监督，包括所有失败组，并确定结果监督的作用位置。CREDO通过比较同一问题的不同推理轨迹来分配阶段级别的正向信用，并使用保留的答案重叠作为机遇代理，将部分结果-策略权重向推理和回答方向转移。该框架保留了终端奖励和轨迹级别的优势，而再分配则确保了每个轨迹的总结果-策略权重。遵循先前工作的公开评估协议，CREDO在MultiTQ上相对于我们比较中最强的已发表基线，将整体准确率从78.0%提升至82.4%，多步准确率从55.0%提升至65.6%。在TimelineKGQA上，通过在匹配的训练和评估设置下直接迁移到ICEWS Actor，相对于我们复现的基线，它将跨知识图谱准确率从30.9%提升至36.4%。

articles.title: BanglishDepYT: Depression Detection in Native Bengali Social Media with Emotion-Preserving Preprocessing and Domain-Adaptive Pretraining
articles.abstract: Depression affects millions of Bengali speakers across South Asia, yet automated detection systems have relied almost entirely on datasets translated from English. Such datasets cannot capture the emoticons, romanized Bengali words, and elongated spellings that characterize real expressions of distress. We introduce BanglishDepYT, a Bengali depression dataset collected natively from YouTube, comprising 191,000 unlabeled comments and 1,000 samples verified through dual bilingual annotation. We propose EPH (Emotion-Preserving Hybrid preprocessing), which converts emoticons to semantic tags, preserves Banglish tokens, protects negation words, and normalizes emotional elongation. A key finding is that preprocessing choice substantially affects performance on informal text: standard cleaning reduces the Banglish Survival Rate to zero (SVM F1: 0.7062), while EPH preserves signals (CESS: 0.9996 vs. 0.6694) and raises SVM F1 to 0.8570, an improvement of 0.1508. We further apply domain-adaptive pretraining (DAPT), continuing SahajBERT pretraining on unlabeled in-domain comments. DAPT-SahajBERT achieves the highest mean F1 (0.8161) and MCC (0.6272), significantly outperforming the baseline (F1: 0.7805, p = 0.0013, d = 1.450) and matching MuRIL (p = 0.589). These results suggest that targeted domain pretraining is a competitive alternative to large-scale multilingual pretraining. LLM-assisted annotation using Qwen2.5-7B achieves substantial human agreement (kappa = 0.611), enabling pseudo-labeling of 96,071 comments. Semi-supervised training improves AUC from 0.8499 to 0.8731 (p = 0.044), offering a scalable path to expanding annotation. All code, models, and datasets are publicly released to support reproducible research.
articles.titleCn: BanglishDepYT：在本土孟加拉语社交媒体中进行抑郁症检测，采用情感保留预处理和领域自适应预训练
articles.abstractCn: 抑郁症影响着南亚数百万孟加拉语使用者，但自动化检测系统几乎完全依赖于从英语翻译而来的数据集。这类数据集无法捕捉表情符号、罗马化孟加拉语词汇和拉长拼写等特征，这些特征是真实情感表达的重要标志。我们介绍了BanglishDepYT，这是一个从YouTube原生收集的孟加拉语抑郁症数据集，包含191,000条未标记的评论和1,000个通过双语双重标注验证的样本。我们提出了EPH（情感保留混合预处理）方法，该方法将表情符号转换为语义标签，保留孟加拉语词汇，保护否定词汇，并规范情感拉长。一个关键发现是，预处理选择对非正式文本的性能有显著影响：标准清理将孟加拉语生存率降至零（SVM F1：0.7062），而EPH保留了信号（CESS：0.9996 vs. 0.6694）并将SVM F1提升至0.8570，提高了0.1508。我们进一步应用了领域自适应预训练（DAPT），在未标记的领域内评论上继续预训练SahajBERT。DAPT-SahajBERT实现了最高的平均F1（0.8161）和MCC（0.6272），显著优于基线（F1：0.7805，p = 0.0013，d = 1.450），并与MuRIL（p = 0.589）持平。这些结果表明，针对特定领域的预训练是一种具有竞争力的替代大规模多语言预训练的方法。使用Qwen2.5-7B的LLM辅助标注实现了显著的人类一致性（kappa = 0.611），使得96,071条评论可以进行伪标注。半监督训练将AUC从0.8499提升至0.8731（p = 0.044），为扩展标注提供了一条可扩展的路径。所有代码、模型和数据集均已公开发布，以支持可重复的研究。

articles.title: FinForesight: A Diagnostic Backtesting Benchmark for Deep Research Systems in Financial Forecasting
articles.abstract: Anticipating financial outcomes requires synthesizing evolving evidence and reasoning under uncertainty, making deep research systems promising tools for forecasting. Yet evaluating forecasting ability is challenging because historical backtests may reward memorized outcomes or information retrieved after the forecast date. Live forecasting avoids direct access to realized outcomes, but feedback arrives only after events resolve. To obtain timely feedback and assess historical scores, we introduce FinForesight, a diagnostic backtesting benchmark for financial deep research systems. Across the Chinese, U.S., and Hong Kong markets, the benchmark evaluates four forecasting tasks: valuation, return ranking, event direction, and future financial fundamentals. Two capability diagnostic tasks assess counterfactual reasoning and financial calculation, scored separately from forecasting performance. Our harness-compatible framework restricts retrieved evidence to information available at the forecast date. We compare pretraining-era, resolved post-cutoff, and live evaluations to test whether controlled backtests approximate future performance. Pretraining-era scores exceed post-cutoff scores in most temporal comparisons, and stronger retrieval controls narrow the gap between post-cutoff backtests and live results. Forecasting attribution and robustness analyses reveal how scores respond to retrieval policy and how predictions respond to prompt rewrites and numerical perturbations. The code and benchmark data are publicly available.
