articles.title: LLM-Enhanced Multimodal House Price Prediction using Structured, Textual, and Visual Features
articles.abstract: Accurate house price prediction is essential for real estate buyers, sellers, agents, and financial institutions. Traditional methods rely primarily on structured data, e.g., number of bedrooms, bathrooms, parkings, but they overlook rich contextual information embedded in textual descriptions and property photos. Previous deep learning approaches for house price prediction have fused multimodal data but they fall short to extract structured spatio-temporal and contextual features from texts and semantic visual information from images. In this paper, we introduce a novel multimodal framework that addresses these limitations by systematically integrating structured attributes, textual descriptions, and visual images of properties to achieve higher prediction accuracy while maintaining interpretability. We use a large language model to derive domain-specific spatio-temporal and contextual features from text, and an unsupervised vision-language approach to automatically group photos into meaningful classes like indoor, outdoor, mixed, or floorplan, that are commonly present in real-world house listings. These categories are created without manual labeling by aligning image clusters with carefully designed pseudo text prompts. We fuse all features into a unified representation and use an optimized regressor to predict prices. Experiments on a large real-world property dataset demonstrate that our method outperforms traditional methods and existing multimodal baselines. Ablation studies confirm that the novel textual feature extraction and categorized visual embeddings substantially contribute to more accurate and reliable price predictions.
articles.titleCn: 基于结构化、文本和视觉特征的LLM增强型多模态房价预测
articles.abstractCn: 精准的房价预测对房地产买家、卖家、中介和金融机构至关重要。传统方法主要依赖结构化数据，例如卧室数量、浴室数量、停车位等，但它们忽略了文本描述和房产照片中蕴含的丰富上下文信息。先前用于房价预测的深度学习方法融合了多模态数据，但在从文本中提取结构化时空和上下文特征以及从图像中提取语义视觉信息方面存在不足。在本文中，我们引入了一种新颖的多模态框架，通过系统地整合房产的结构化属性、文本描述和视觉图像，以在保持可解释性的同时实现更高的预测精度。我们使用大型语言模型从文本中提取特定领域的时空和上下文特征，并采用无监督的视觉语言方法自动将照片分组到有意义的类别中，如室内、室外、混合或平面图，这些类别在现实世界的房产列表中很常见。这些类别无需人工标注，通过将图像簇与精心设计的伪文本提示进行对齐来创建。我们将所有特征融合为统一的表示，并使用优化的回归器来预测价格。在大型真实世界房产数据集上的实验表明，我们的方法优于传统方法和现有的多模态基线。消融研究证实，新颖的文本特征提取和分类化的视觉嵌入对更准确和可靠的房价预测做出了实质性贡献。

articles.title: Halal-NeSyNet: Clause-Scoped Neuro-Symbolic Cross-Attention for Automated Food Ingredient Auditing and Risk-Aware Halal Logistics Triage
articles.abstract: Verifying that a packaged food is Halal requires reading ingredient declarations and E-number additives before goods enter certified warehouses. Dual-origin additives such as E471, E422, E441 and E920 are Mushbooh (doubtful) unless a botanical, microbial or certified-Halal qualifier appears in the same ingredient clause, so a plant-based qualifier on one clause must not clear an unqualified additive in another. We call a failure to respect this scope cross-clause modifier confounding and build a benchmark of 3,199 items (277 Open Food Facts records and 2,922 template-generated clause-swap items, labelled by an explicit 50-code rule base rather than by a certification authority) with a 540-item counterfactual suite. We propose Halal-NeSyNet, which couples a DistilBERT encoder with a 16-dimensional rule-derived symbolic vector through cross-attention and gated fusion, trained with an asymmetric false-Halal risk loss. Over five seeds, text-only TF-IDF baselines reach 86.25-86.71 % accuracy with 13.42-21.73 % false-Halal leakage and 6.33-26.00 % counterfactual triad consistency, whereas Halal-NeSyNet reaches 97.04+/-0.34 % and 99.67+/-0.50 %. Gradient boosting given the same symbolic vector reaches 96.25+/-1.24 % (+0.59 points from Halal-NeSyNet, 95 % CI [-1.11, +2.28]), so most of the gain comes from clause-scoped symbolic features and not from the network, and the risk loss did not help. Holding out whole template families, text-only models fall to 61.91-78.35 %, Halal-NeSyNet to 90.87+/-11.76 % and logistic regression with the symbolic vector to 91.11+/-2.88 %, with far more spread for Halal-NeSyNet. A three-lane receiving simulation auto-clears 49.33 % of cargo at 0.76 % green-lane contamination. Because labels and features come from one rule engine and 91.3 % of the items are templated, the results measure fidelity to a rule policy, not religious certification.
articles.titleCn: Halal-NeSyNet：面向条款范围的神经符号交叉注意力机制，用于自动化食品成分审核与风险感知的清真物流分拣
articles.abstractCn: 验证包装食品是否符合清真要求需要在货物进入认证仓库前检查成分声明和E编号添加剂。像E471、E422、E441和E920这样的双重来源添加剂，除非在同一成分条款中出现了植物来源、微生物来源或认证清真的限定词，否则被视为Mushbooh（可疑的），因此一个条款中的植物来源限定词不能使另一个未限定的添加剂得到豁免。我们称未能遵守这一范围跨条款修饰为混淆，并构建了一个包含3,199个项目（277个Open Food Facts记录和2,922个模板生成的条款交换项目，通过明确的50码规则库而非认证机构进行标记）以及540项反事实套件的标准。我们提出了Halal-NeSyNet，该模型结合了DistilBERT编码器和16维规则推导的符号向量，通过交叉注意力和门控融合进行训练，并使用非对称假清真风险损失。在五个种子下，纯文本TF-IDF基线达到86.25-86.71%的准确率，假清真泄漏率为13.42-21.73%，反事实三元组一致性为6.33-26.00%，而Halal-NeSyNet达到97.04+/-0.34%和99.67+/-0.50%。给定相同的符号向量，梯度提升达到96.25+/-1.24%（比Halal-NeSyNet高0.59个百分点，95%置信区间为[-1.11, +2.28]），因此大部分提升来自条款范围的符号特征，而非网络本身，风险损失并未带来帮助。保留整个模板家族，纯文本模型降至61.91-78.35%，Halal-NeSyNet降至90.87+/-11.76%，而使用符号向量的逻辑回归降至91.11+/-2.88%，Halal-NeSyNet的离散程度更大。一个三条车道接收模拟自动清关49.33%的货物，绿色通道污染率为0.76%。由于标签和特征来自同一个规则引擎，且91.3%的项目是模板生成的，因此结果衡量的是对规则政策的忠实度，而非宗教认证。

articles.title: Can Large Language Models Extend Their Agentic Capabilities to Goal Pursuit in Open-Ended Multi-Turn Interaction?
articles.abstract: Goal pursuit in open-ended dialogue requires agents to adapt their actions to interaction feedback across successive exchanges. We investigate whether agentic capabilities developed for multi-step tool use carry over to dialogue organized through the model's native tool interface, and how this changes interaction behavior. We define Tool-Mediated Interaction (TMI) as a training-free protocol that represents dialogue actions as tool calls and counterpart responses as tool results, maintaining a continuous reasoning-action-observation loop with retained reasoning and interaction history. We evaluate TMI across social interaction, emotional support, persuasion, and price negotiation using two models and 15,678 main-experiment episodes. Across both models, TMI improves social goal attainment, emotional-support preference, donation amounts, and buyer negotiation margins over conversational baselines with and without thinking. A Qwen ablation further shows that TMI outperforms ordinary conversation with retained reasoning on all four primary outcomes. Behavioral analyses associate the improvements with task-specific patterns in initial proposals and responses to interaction feedback. Alongside these gains, TMI reduces mean reasoning tokens per decision by 42.0-81.5% relative to the thinking baseline and lowers mean cross-turn phrase reuse across all eight model-environment pairs. These findings show that interaction organization shapes both goal attainment and reasoning across dialogue turns.
articles.titleCn: 大型语言模型能否将其代理能力扩展到开放式多轮交互中的目标追求？
articles.abstractCn: 开放式对话中的目标追求需要智能体根据连续交互中的反馈调整其行为。我们研究了为多步工具使用开发的智能体能力是否能够迁移到通过模型原生工具界面组织的对话中，以及这种迁移如何改变交互行为。我们将工具中介交互（Tool-Mediated Interaction, TMI）定义为一个无需训练的协议，该协议将对话行为表示为工具调用，将交互方响应表示为工具结果，并保持一个包含推理、行动和观察历史的连续推理-行动-观察循环。我们使用两个模型和15,678个主要实验片段，在社交互动、情感支持、说服和价格谈判四个场景中评估了TMI。在两个模型中，TMI均优于有思考和无思考的对话基线，提升了社交目标达成度、情感支持偏好度、捐款金额和买家谈判利润。进一步的Qwen消融实验表明，TMI在四个主要结果上均优于保留推理的普通对话。行为分析将改进效果归因于初始提议和针对交互反馈的响应中的任务特定模式。与此同时，与思考基线相比，TMI将每项决策的平均推理token数量减少了42.0-81.5%，并降低了所有八组模型-环境组合中的跨回合短语重复率。这些发现表明，交互组织方式塑造了对话回合中的目标达成和推理过程。

articles.title: Revisiting LLM Homogeneity Through a Multidimensional Lens
articles.abstract: Concerns about LLM homogeneity are typically quantified with embedding similarity, which reduces two texts to a single score. We revisit homogeneity with 25 interpretable metrics spanning five dimensions: semantic, lexical, syntactic, structural, and stylistic & presentational. A human study shows that perceived similarity depends on both content (what responses say) and form (how they say it), yet embedding similarity correlates less with human meaning judgments than sentence-level matching ($ρ=0.417$ vs. $0.606$) and not significantly with form judgments ($ρ=0.140$). Across 18 contemporary LLMs, models say similar things in different words: they share global semantics and broad linguistic profiles but remain distinct in lexical characteristics, structural patterns, and interactional conventions. Across releases from 2024 to 2026, models become more like themselves but not more like one another: among significantly changing metrics, intra-model distances decrease for 17 of 22, and inter-model distances increase for 14 of 21. Across two post-training pipelines, model-specific conventions emerge during SFT and are selectively reshaped by preference optimization. These results suggest that homogeneity is multidimensional and evolving, and that embedding similarity alone can overstate cross-model homogeneity while concealing diverging intra- and inter-model trends.
articles.titleCn: 从多维视角重新审视大语言模型的同质性
articles.abstractCn: 对大型语言模型同质性的担忧通常通过嵌入相似度来量化，将两段文本简化为一个分数。我们重新审视同质性，采用涵盖五个维度的25个可解释指标：语义、词汇、句法、结构和风格与呈现。一项人类研究表明，感知相似度取决于内容（回答说了什么）和形式（如何表达），但嵌入相似度与人类意义判断的相关性低于句子级匹配（$ρ=0.417$ 对 $0.606$），且与形式判断的相关性不显著（$ρ=0.140$）。在18个当代大型语言模型中，模型用不同措辞表达相似内容：它们共享全局语义和广泛的语言特征，但在词汇特征、结构模式和交互规范上保持独特。从2024年到2026年的版本发布中，模型越来越像自己，但不像彼此：在显著变化的指标中，22个中的17个模型内距离减小，21个中的14个模型间距离增大。在两个后训练流程中，特定模型的规范在SFT（监督微调）期间出现，并通过偏好优化被选择性地重塑。这些结果表明，同质性是多维且演变的，而仅依赖嵌入相似度会高估跨模型同质性，同时掩盖模型内和模型间的分化趋势。

articles.title: The Structure of Disagreement in Emotion Annotation
articles.abstract: Calculating inter-annotator agreement is an established practice in NLP, and disagreement-aware work increasingly retains the distribution of human judgments rather than reducing annotations to a single gold label. Keeping the distribution, however, does not explain why annotators disagree. This paper examines the types of disagreement that occur in emotion annotation, starting from multilabel annotations of 1,677 sentence-level units from Ernest Hemingway's The Old Man and the Sea and testing the patterns they reveal against individual-level annotations from BRIGHTER and GoEmotions. Across the three datasets, we find three main recurring disagreement structures. Emotion categories overlap systematically; annotators differ both in how broadly they apply labels and in how they treat particular category boundaries, while sparse participation and explicit abstention can look like disagreement. Where intensity is rated, disagreement over whether an emotion is present can be separated from disagreement over its intensity once recognized. Similar aggregate disagreement can therefore arise from qualitatively different annotation processes. Hard aggregation removes most of this structure, while annotator vote-share representations keep marginal label frequencies but not the co-occurrence, annotator-specific, or procedural patterns that produced them. We argue that disagreement should be understood in terms of its underlying patterns before it is summarized, aggregated, or used as a modeling target, and propose a vocabulary for disagreement structure.
articles.titleCn: 情感标注中分歧的结构
articles.abstractCn: 计算标注者间一致性是自然语言处理领域的一项成熟实践，而越来越多的研究关注标注者间分歧，而非将标注简化为单一黄金标签。然而，保留标注分布并不能解释标注者为何存在分歧。本文考察了情感标注中出现的分歧类型，以海明威《老人与海》中1677个句子级单元的多标签标注为起点，并将揭示的规律与BRIGHTER和GoEmotions数据集中的个体级标注进行对比。在三个数据集中，我们发现三种主要的反复出现的分歧结构。情感类别存在系统性的重叠；标注者在标签的广泛适用性以及特定类别边界的处理方式上存在差异，而稀疏参与和明确弃权也可能被视为分歧。在评估强度时，一旦确认情感存在，关于情感是否存在与其强度上的分歧可以区分开来。因此，看似相似的总体分歧可能源于性质不同的标注过程。硬聚合会消除大部分这种结构，而标注者投票份额表示法保留了边缘标签频率，但丢失了产生它们的共现、标注者特定或程序性模式。我们认为，在总结、聚合或将其作为建模目标之前，应先理解分歧的潜在模式，并提出了一个用于分歧结构的词汇表。

articles.title: Write Facts the Way Models Read Them: Lifting the Two-Hop Curse
articles.abstract: A language model that learns a new fact by fine-tuning can repeat it but cannot reason with it: taught that a person is a citizen of a new country, it still cannot say, without chain-of-thought, who the head of state of that person's country is. This two-hop curse is widely treated as a reasoning deficit, and the strongest knowledge editors answer it with synthesized reasoning data. We show that the reasoning is intact and the writing is wrong. Fine-tuning writes a new fact as an answer to be said, whereas the second hop reads the bridge ("that person's country") as an entity, from the middle layers on: patching the model's own representation of the entity into the bridge at those layers largely restores the second hop, yet after fine-tuning the bridge there is no closer to the new entity than before the edit. We therefore propose read-equivalent writing (Legible): one loss term makes the bridge phrase, at the layer where the second hop finishes reading it, match the model's own reading of the new entity, and keeps the same relation's other subjects unchanged. Phrases and targets come from the edited model itself, and no multi-hop training data is used. Across Qwen2.5, Llama-3 and Qwen3, Legible (I) composes learned facts more often than the model composes its own knowledge, on MQuAKE's two-hop-curse questions; (II) reaches 1.8-2.6x the bridge accuracy of CaKE, whose reasoning data composes no better than plain fine-tuning, and has the best average over composition, accuracy and locality against four families of writers; and (III) lifts the curse on RippleEdits, on the benchmark of Balesni et al., who named the curse, and at 14B.
articles.titleCn: 以模型阅读的方式呈现事实：解除两跳诅咒
articles.abstractCn: 一种通过微调学习新事实的语言模型能够重复该事实，但不能进行推理：即使被教知某人是新国家的公民，它仍然无法在没有思维链的情况下说出该国元首是谁。这种两跳诅咒通常被视为推理缺陷，而最强的知识编辑器通过合成推理数据来应对它。我们证明推理是完好的，而写法是错误的。微调将新事实作为要说的答案写入，而第二跳将“那个人所在的国家”读作实体，从中间层开始：将模型自身的实体表示修补到这些层的桥接处，可以很大程度上恢复第二跳，但在编辑桥接后，新实体与之前的距离并没有更近。因此，我们提出了可读等价写法（Legible）：一个损失项使桥接短语在第二跳读完它的层上，与模型对新实体的自身阅读相匹配，并保持同一关系中的其他主语不变。短语和目标来自编辑后的模型本身，没有使用多跳训练数据。在Qwen2.5、Llama-3和Qwen3上，Legible（I）在MQuAKE的两跳诅咒问题中，比模型自己编造知识更频繁地编造学习到的事实；（II）达到CaKE桥接准确率的1.8-2.6倍，CaKE的推理数据编造得并不比普通微调更好，并且在组合、准确率和局部性方面对四种类型的写法表现最佳；（III）在Balesni等人命名该诅咒的基准测试RippleEdits上消除了诅咒，并在14B规模上实现。

articles.title: VLMs Read Aloud: The Gap Between Recognizing and Using Visual Text
articles.abstract: Visual-text compression renders long contexts as images and is engineered around how much of the text a vision-language model (VLM) can recover. Yet recovered text is not usable text. VLMs can transcribe the text in an image word for word and still fail to answer from it; given back their own transcript, they answer nearly as well as from the original text. We call this difference the read-use gap. Recognizing and using visual text have different resolution requirements: Qwen3-VL-8B's recognition saturates at 15-pixel characters while use catches up only at 24 pixels, and scaling from 2B to 32B raises recognition without narrowing the gap. Putting the evidence into words closes it: thinking VLMs recite the evidence in their thinking, and their own transcript, written without seeing the question, recovers most of what thinking adds. In a preregistered held-out test, the gap ranks how much eight VLMs gain from their own words over pixels (Spearman $ρ$ = 0.86), which recognition rates do not. We propose ALOUD, which spends visual resolution on finding and recognizing evidence and language tokens on using it. Without keeping the source text, it doubles the accuracy of a frozen Qwen3-VL-8B on long documents compressed 5x and 10x: at 5x, from 27.7% to 54.8%, near the original text's 58.5%, with a context smaller than the compressed pages themselves. For less than the cost of reading the original text, it leads at equal budget every method that does without it, at every level, and beats AGAR and VERA, which paste the original text back; at 5x it also beats LensVLM-9B, which is trained and keeps the original text. Visual-text compression is limited not by how much text a model can recover, but by how much it can use.
articles.titleCn: VLMs朗读：识别与使用视觉文本之间的差距
articles.abstractCn: 视觉-文本压缩将长文本转换为图像，其设计围绕视觉语言模型（VLM）能恢复多少文本。然而，恢复的文本并非可用文本。VLM可以逐字转录图像中的文本，但仍无法从中回答问题；即使得到自己的转录文本，它们的回答效果也几乎与原始文本相同。我们将这种差异称为“阅读-使用差距”。识别和使用视觉文本有不同的分辨率要求：Qwen3-VL-8B的识别在15像素字符时达到饱和，而使用仅在24像素时才跟上，并且从2B扩展到32B提升了识别能力，却并未缩小差距。将证据用文字表达可以解释这一现象：我们认为VLM在思考时会复述证据，而它们自己未经查看问题的转录文本，恢复了思考所增加的大部分内容。在一项已预注册的保留测试中，差距排名显示了八个VLM从自己的文字中比从像素中获得的收益（Spearman $ρ$ = 0.86），而识别率则没有这种效果。我们提出了ALOUD，它将视觉分辨率用于寻找和识别证据，而将语言标记用于使用它们。在不保留源文本的情况下，它将冻结的Qwen3-VL-8B在5倍和10倍压缩的长文档上的准确率翻倍：在5倍压缩时，从27.7%提升到54.8%，接近原始文本的58.5%，且上下文小于压缩页面本身。以低于阅读原始文本的成本，它使所有不依赖原始文本的方法在同等预算下表现最佳，并在各个层面超越粘贴原始文本的AGAR和VERA，在5倍压缩时也超越了训练并保留原始文本的LensVLM-9B。视觉-文本压缩的限制不在于模型能恢复多少文本，而在于能使用多少文本。

articles.title: Sweep Less, Steer More: Using Activation Steering Geometry for Reduced Hyperparameter Search
articles.abstract: Representation steering methods like difference-in-means (DIM) offer a lightweight approach to controlling LLM behavior, but their effectiveness varies widely across concepts, datasets, and layers, making principled deployment costly without exhaustive hyperparameter sweeps. We build on the discriminability index $d'$, a compute-cheap geometric measure of how well contrastive training activations separate along the steering direction. Across five behaviors on 3 models, we demonstrate uses beyond its established role as a dataset-level steerability predictor. First, in the multiple-choice question answering (MCQA) setting, we show that $d'$ reliably identifies performant layers at which to steer, eliminating the need for a layer-wise sweep. Second, we extend this analysis to open-ended multi-token generation, and find that $d'$ remains successful for layer selection across different settings. Lastly, we test whether the position of a generated token's representation on the DIM line predicts steering success on that individual example. In the MCQA setting, this works for high-$d'$ datasets but is inconsistent across behaviors, models, and training-token choices in open-ended generation. This highlights that methods developed and conclusions drawn in single-token MCQA settings do not necessarily transfer to open-ended generation.
articles.titleCn: 少扫多导：利用激活引导几何形状减少超参数搜索
articles.abstractCn: 差异均值（DIM）等表示引导方法为控制大型语言模型（LLM）行为提供了一种轻量级途径，但其有效性在概念、数据集和层之间差异很大，在没有进行彻底超参数扫描的情况下，其原则性部署成本高昂。我们基于判别性指数 $d'$，这是一个计算成本低的几何度量，用于衡量对比训练激活在引导方向上的分离程度。在三个模型上的五种行为中，我们展示了 $d'$ 除了作为数据集级引导性预测器之外的其他用途。首先，在多项选择题问答（MCQA）设置中，我们证明 $d'$ 可靠地识别出引导性能良好的层，从而消除了逐层扫描的需求。其次，我们将此分析扩展到开放式多标记生成，发现 $d'$ 在不同设置中仍适用于层选择。最后，我们测试生成标记的表示在DIM线上的位置是否可以预测在该特定示例上的引导成功。在MCQA设置中，这对高-$d'$ 数据集有效，但在开放式生成中，其结果在不同行为、模型和训练标记选择中不一致。这表明在单标记MCQA设置中开发的方法和得出的结论不一定能迁移到开放式生成。

articles.title: TopoSteer: Topological Layer Selection for Activation Steering in LLMs
articles.abstract: Activation steering controls large language models at inference time by adding a vector to their internal representations. Most work asks how to build that vector, and far less attention has gone to where to add it, even though steering at a poorly chosen layer can be worse than not steering at all. Prior selectors choose a layer without ever steering the model to test it: they score how separable the target behavior is at that layer, and how consistently the individual examples point along the steering direction. We argue that what matters is not the separability of the two activation clouds, nor the alignment of individual displacements with their mean, but the extent of the cloud of per-example displacements that mean-difference steering averages. We propose a topology-based layer selection method, called TopoSteer, which scores a layer by the total H_0 persistence of its displacement cloud, computed as the length of the cloud's Euclidean minimum spanning tree. We show that the score focuses on the displacement cloud's relative geometry, while class separation affects it only through standardization. We also provide a theoretical explanation for our method by proving that, as example-level variation increases, TopoSteer and discriminability move in opposite directions, so the two criteria can rank layers in opposite ways. Across multiple language models and steering tasks, TopoSteer provides a principled alternative to discriminability- and separability-based layer selection and yields more effective steering without requiring held-out validation.
articles.titleCn: TopoSteer：用于LLM激活引导的拓扑层选择
articles.abstractCn: 激活引导通过向大型语言模型的内部表征中添加一个向量来在推理时控制模型。大多数研究关注如何构建这个向量，而很少关注将其添加到何处，尽管在选定的层上引导模型可能比完全不引导更糟糕。先验选择器在不引导模型的情况下选择一个层进行测试：它们评估目标行为在该层的可分离性，以及单个样本在引导方向上的一致性。我们认为重要的是两个激活云的可分离性，以及单个位移与其均值的一致性，而不是每个样本位移云在均值差引导下平均的程度。我们提出了一种基于拓扑的层选择方法，称为TopoSteer，它通过位移云的总H_0持久性来评估一个层，该持久性计算为云的欧几里得最小生成树的长度。我们证明该评分关注位移云的相对几何形状，而类分离性仅通过标准化影响它。我们还通过证明随着样本级变异的增加，TopoSteer和可区分性向相反方向变化，从而为我们的方法提供了理论解释，因此这两个标准可以以相反的方式对层进行排序。在多个语言模型和引导任务中，TopoSteer为基于可区分性和可分离性的层选择提供了一种原则性替代方案，并在无需保留验证的情况下实现了更有效的引导。

articles.title: Accounting for Irregular State Transitions through Belief Estimation in Online Medical Consultation
articles.abstract: While online medical consultation broadens access, unprompted patient disclosures and topic shifts frequently disrupt clinician inquiry, leaving clinical states progressively revealed. We characterize these dynamics using both existing evaluation metrics and task-specific interaction metrics designed in this work. Through an empirical study across 16 medical dialogue datasets, we show that authentic online interactions exhibit substantially lower contextual continuity and higher unpredictability than offline and simulated benchmarks. We propose PRISM (Policy Reasoning with Inferred States for Medicine), a framework inspired by partially observable Markov decision processes that decouples latent state estimation from action selection to address drifting dialogue trajectories. Specifically, PRISM factorizes clinical triage into belief estimation, policy optimization, and response realization. By maintaining an evolving posterior belief over consultation states and conditioning action selection on the maximum a posteriori state, PRISM advances clinical goals while accommodating patient-initiated shifts. Extensive evaluations show that PRISM substantially outperforms frontier LLMs and clinical agents, achieving a 22.40 percentage point gain in clinical decision accuracy alongside decisive improvements in response generation, surpassing the strongest baseline by 5.51 points in BERTScore_F1. Furthermore, ablation studies show that providing oracle consultation states consistently boosts response quality across all evaluated baselines by guiding their action reasoning, yielding average gains of 5.58 points in BERTScore_F1.
articles.titleCn: 通过信念估计在线医疗咨询中的非规则状态转换
articles.abstractCn: 虽然在线医疗咨询拓宽了医疗服务的可及性，但未经提示的患者信息披露和话题转换频繁打断临床医生的询问，导致临床状态逐步被揭示。我们利用现有的评估指标和本工作设计的工作特定交互指标来刻画这些动态。通过跨16个医疗对话数据集的实证研究，我们表明，真实的在线交互比线下和模拟基准具有显著更低的上下文连续性和更高的不可预测性。我们提出了PRISM（基于推断状态的医疗政策推理），一个受部分可观察马尔可夫决策过程启发的框架，将潜在状态估计与动作选择解耦，以应对对话轨迹的漂移。具体而言，PRISM将临床分诊分解为信念估计、策略优化和响应实现。通过维持对咨询状态的不断演变的后验信念，并在动作选择上基于最大后验状态，PRISM在适应患者发起的转换的同时推进临床目标。广泛的评估表明，PRISM显著优于前沿的大型语言模型和临床代理，在临床决策准确率上实现了22.40个百分点的提升，同时在响应生成方面取得决定性改进，在BERTScore_F1上超越最强基线5.51分。此外，消融研究表明，提供神谕咨询状态始终通过指导其动作推理来提升所有评估基线的响应质量，在BERTScore_F1上平均提升5.58分。

articles.title: See, Think, Use: Diagnosing Perception and Reasoning Failures in VLMs
articles.abstract: We present See, Think, Use, a protocol that traces each answer of a vision-language model to perception, reasoning or the use of perception. The diagnosis shows a developer which stage to improve and directs test-time compute to the stage that fails. Benchmarks score the final answer, and an answer that rests on the image earns the same credit as a guess or a memorized prior. The protocol asks the model two extra questions per item and needs no access to its weights. A localization probe asks for a box around every instance and measures seeing, and a text-replacement probe answers from a description and measures thinking. Use is the rate at which the answer follows the model's own perception across counterfactual image pairs. The rate needs no answer labels, because the question and its prior are the same on both images. On two model families and six datasets the protocol shows that the knob that helps follows the task family. Answers follow the model's perception except on images that contradict a common prior, and asking the model to localize first repairs this failure when its boxes are right. Allocating compute by the measured stages comes close to the best uniform policy at lower cost and beats a random allocation of the same compute wherever a knob raises the short stage. We will release the code, the prompts and the per-question outputs.
articles.titleCn: 看见、思考、使用：诊断视觉语言模型中的感知和推理错误
articles.abstractCn: 我们提出了See, Think, Use协议，该协议追踪视觉语言模型每个答案到感知、推理或感知使用的路径。诊断结果能帮助开发者确定需要改进的阶段，并引导测试时的计算资源分配到失败阶段。基准测试对最终答案进行评分，基于图像的答案与猜测或记忆中的先验知识获得相同的信用。该协议每项问题额外询问两个问题，且无需访问模型权重。定位探测请求围绕每个实例的框，并测量感知能力；文本替换探测从描述中回答问题，并测量推理能力。使用是指答案遵循模型自身感知在反事实图像对中的速率。该速率无需答案标签，因为两个图像上的问题和先验知识相同。在两个模型系列和六个数据集上，该协议表明有助于遵循任务系列的旋钮。答案遵循模型的感知，除了与共同先验相矛盾的图像，而要求模型首先定位可以修复这种失败，当其框正确时。根据测量阶段分配计算资源接近最佳统一策略，且在较低成本下优于随机分配相同计算资源，只要旋钮提高了短期阶段。我们将发布代码、提示和每项问题的输出。

articles.title: Can Large Language Model Agents Learn by Watching Tutorial Videos?
articles.abstract: Humans continuously acquire knowledge from carefully crafted materials such as books and tutorial videos, carrying that understanding into future tasks. Millions of such instructional videos are uploaded online every day, yet LLM agents remain unable to exploit this ever-expanding wealth of human teaching. Their capabilities are frozen after training, while parameter updates at scale remain prohibitively expensive. This raises the central question: can LLM agents learn from this vast instructional resource without parameter updates? We introduce Tutorial Agentic Learning (TAL), a nonparametric continual-learning paradigm that consolidates tutorial videos into a persistent, structured tutorialbook memory through a two-stage adversarial process that harvests hard, video-grounded questions and uses them to refine the memory. At inference time, TAL retrieves through a Table-of-Contents (TOC) tree, tying retrieval directly to the model's reasoning rather than to embedding similarity. To study this setting, we introduce VidLearn, a multimodal QA benchmark built from 72 chess tutorial videos spanning 12 openings. On VidLearn, TAL outperforms all evaluated baselines and improves monotonically as more videos are consumed, achieving up to 113% and 91% relative gains over the corresponding vanilla MLLMs on the training and test splits, respectively. In actual gameplay, TAL reaches a stronger opening-phase position than its vanilla counterpart in 69% of head-to-head games. Evaluation in a second domain further demonstrates the generality of TAL. Together, these results highlight instructional videos as a scalable resource for parameter-update-free agent continual learning.
articles.titleCn: 大型语言模型代理能否通过观看教学视频来学习？
articles.abstractCn: 人类持续从精心制作的材料（如书籍和教学视频）中获取知识，并将这些理解应用于未来的任务。每天都有数百万这样的教学视频上传到网上，但大型语言模型代理仍然无法利用这不断增长的人类教学资源。它们的性能在训练后便固定不变，而大规模参数更新仍然成本高昂。这提出了一个核心问题：大型语言模型代理能否在不进行参数更新的情况下从这些庞大的教学资源中学习？我们介绍了教程代理学习（TAL），这是一种非参数的持续学习范式，通过一个两阶段对抗过程将教学视频整合到持久、结构化的教程书记忆中，该过程采集基于视频的硬问题，并利用这些问题来优化记忆。在推理时，TAL通过目录树（TOC）进行检索，将检索直接与模型的推理过程绑定，而不是依赖于嵌入相似度。为了研究这一场景，我们引入了VidLearn，这是一个基于72个涵盖12种开局的多模态问答基准，由国际象棋教程视频构建。在VidLearn上，TAL优于所有评估的基线模型，并且随着更多视频的摄入，性能单调提升，在训练集和测试集上分别比相应的普通大型语言模型提高了113%和91%。在实际对弈中，TAL在69%的直面对弈中比其普通版本获得更强的开局阶段位置。在第二个领域的评估进一步证明了TAL的通用性。综合这些结果，凸显了教学视频作为无需参数更新的代理持续学习的可扩展资源。

articles.title: When Should an Agent Refresh? Adaptive Index Reuse for Efficient Long-Horizon Reasoning
articles.abstract: Language agents read code, tool output, and dialogue in contexts that grow at every step. Dynamic sparse attention lets a small indexer choose the earlier tokens each query attends to, but the indexer still scores the whole prefix at every layer. Cross-layer reuse methods such as IndexCache rerun the indexer at only some layers, with one fixed pattern for every input. In an agent, the relevant evidence can change abruptly when a traceback or test result arrives, so fresh selections matter more at some steps than at others. We propose Adaptive Index Reuse (AIR), which keeps IndexCache's execution and learns, for each segment of an agent episode, how many layers refresh their selection. A small controller reads signals from completed computation and the latest tool event, chooses a pattern from a nested library, and learns from terminal task reward under an expected compute budget. On Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 with a 128K context, AIR improves success over the strongest static schedule at matched cost on SWE-bench Verified (27.0% to 32.4%), Terminal-Bench 2.0, and three $τ^2$-bench domains, and it lowers time per successful task on all five. Across 50 backbone, context, and benchmark settings, it matches or exceeds that schedule in 44.
articles.titleCn: 何时刷新代理？高效长时推理的自适应索引重用
articles.abstractCn: 语言代理在逐步增长的上下文中读取代码、工具输出和对话。动态稀疏注意力机制允许一个小型索引器选择每个查询关注较早的标记，但索引器仍然在每个层级上对整个前缀进行评分。跨层级重用方法，如IndexCache，仅在部分层级上重新运行索引器，并为每个输入使用一个固定的模式。在一个代理中，当出现回溯或测试结果时，相关证据可能会突然变化，因此某些步骤比其他步骤更需要新鲜的选择。我们提出了自适应索引重用（AIR），它保留IndexCache的执行，并学习代理会话的每个片段需要刷新多少层的选择。一个小型控制器读取完成计算的信号和最新的工具事件，从嵌套库中选择一个模式，并在预期的计算预算下从终端任务奖励中学习。在具有128K上下文的Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507上，AIR在SWE-bench验证（27.0%到32.4%）、Terminal-Bench 2.0和三个$τ^2$-bench领域上以匹配成本提高了成功率，并在所有五个任务上降低了每项成功任务的时间。在50个主干、上下文和基准设置中，它在44个设置中达到了或超过了该计划。

articles.title: Towards Fine-grained and Robust Detection of Human-AI Co-authorship
articles.abstract: The widespread adoption of large language models (LLMs) is reshaping how textual content is produced, complicating text provenance, and raising concerns for misinformation, plagiarism, and intellectual property. While prior work on AI-generated text detection has progressed, one-dimensional human-AI co-authorship scores lack signals directly relevant to ``AI involvement''. It remains unclear how adversarial paraphrasing distorts detection signals. In this work, we formulate a discrete-class text provenance detection framework. This framework allows an abstraction of realistic co-authorship scenarios into distinct degrees of AI involvement, differentiating the AI polishing on the surface level from the AI updating the discourse structures. This framework reveals the mechanisms of how adversarial paraphrasing blurs the decision boundaries for co-authorship detectors. To improve robustness of the detectors, we augment training data with adversarial paraphrases generated by the state-of-the-art paraphrasing attack model, exposing detectors to challenging meaning-preserving rewrites. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets and generation models demonstrate that adversarial paraphrasing substantially degrades detectors trained only on benign data, while adversarial data augmentation leads to consistent robustness gains and good cross-generator transferability. Overall, our findings highlight the value of discrete-class formulation and principled data augmentation for building reliable detectors of human-AI co-authorship.
articles.titleCn: 面向细粒度与鲁棒性的人类-AI合著检测
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）的广泛应用正在重塑文本内容的生成方式，使文本来源变得复杂，并引发了关于虚假信息、剽窃和知识产权的担忧。尽管在AI生成文本检测方面已有先前研究，但一维的人类-AI合著评分缺乏直接与“AI参与”相关的信号。目前尚不清楚对抗性释义如何扭曲检测信号。在这项工作中，我们构建了一个离散类文本来源检测框架。该框架允许将现实中的合著场景抽象为不同的AI参与程度，区分了表面层次的AI润色和更新话语结构的AI。该框架揭示了对抗性释义如何模糊合著检测器的决策边界。为了提高检测器的鲁棒性，我们使用最先进的释义攻击模型生成的对抗性释义来增强训练数据，使检测器面临具有挑战性的意义保持性重写。在多个数据集和生成模型上的大量实验表明，对抗性释义会显著降低仅在良性数据上训练的检测器的性能，而对抗性数据增强则带来了持续的性能提升和良好的跨生成器迁移能力。总体而言，我们的研究强调了离散类公式化和原则性数据增强在构建可靠的人类-AI合著检测器中的价值。

articles.title: FlyWheel: Attention Kernels Built for the TPU
articles.abstract: Attention kernels on Tensor Processing Units (TPUs) often underutilize their matrix units (MXUs) because of repeated matrix operand loads, vector-intensive computation, and dependencies that leave MXUs idle. We present FlyWheel, a set of fast TPU kernels for both softmax and linear attention. FlyWheel reformulates softmax and triangular inversion to reduce vector work, while coordinating data layouts to improve matrix operand reuse. It then overlaps independent computation to hide execution latency. We apply these techniques to both softmax attention and Gated DeltaNet on TPU v6e and v7x. FlyWheel speeds up softmax attention by up to $4.14\times$ over the state-of-the-art RPA kernel and $1.80\times$ over Splash Attention, reaching 81% of peak BF16 throughput on v6e. It also speeds up Gated DeltaNet prefill by up to $3.61\times$. Integrated into vLLM serving Qwen3.8-27B, FlyWheel improves prefill throughput by up to $1.56\times$ while maintaining comparable accuracy.
articles.titleCn: 飞轮：为TPU构建的注意力核
articles.abstractCn: 在张量处理单元（TPU）上，注意力核（Attention kernels）常常因为重复的矩阵操作数加载、向量密集型计算以及导致矩阵单元（MXUs）空闲的依赖关系而未能充分利用其矩阵单元。我们提出了FlyWheel，这是一套用于softmax和线性注意力的快速TPU核。FlyWheel通过重新表述softmax和三角反演来减少向量工作，同时协调数据布局以提高矩阵操作数的重用。然后，它通过重叠独立计算来隐藏执行延迟。我们将这些技术应用于TPU v6e和v7x上的softmax注意力和Gated DeltaNet。FlyWheel将softmax注意力速度提高了4.14倍，超过最先进的RPA核，提高了1.80倍，超过Splash Attention，在v6e上达到81%的BF16峰值吞吐量。它还将Gated DeltaNet预填充速度提高了3.61倍。集成到vLLM服务Qwen3.8-27B中，FlyWheel在保持相当准确性的同时，将预填充吞吐量提高了1.56倍。

articles.title: Latent Harness: Compiling Agent Behaviors into Post-Block Activation Shifts
articles.abstract: Harness engineering and self-evolving agents improve language-model agents quickly, yet their gains live outside the model. The harness is re-sent and re-paid on every call, and the standard route to internalization is a weight update that is costly to iterate and fixed once merged. We propose compiling the harness instead. Latent Harness distills an external condition into a rank-8 activation shift. The shift is applied at the output of every decoder block of a frozen backbone, at 0.03-0.05% of parameters. The condition is either an explicit process-level behavior instruction or the behavioral contract of an agentic harness. At inference the compiled bundle carries no harness text and adds no tokens. It exposes three runtime controls for injection strength, injection phase, and shift-space mixing. Compiled behaviors recover the source-harness gain in 8 of 10 preregistered settings. Where the explicit source pays the heaviest per-call token tax, the compiled form exceeds it. The same bundles transfer zero-shot across tasks (5 of 7 pairs positive) and compose in shift space, while stacked text instructions interfere destructively. Used as a search space, they lift budget-matched harness search by 1.45 times. On three agentic benchmarks the operator aligns policy to the harness con- tract. Under matched data, capacity, and effective strength it outperforms same-capacity LoRA, which needs 11.1 times the parameters to reach the same band, and it regresses nothing where the base policy is already strong. Across 1B-to-8B models the method skeleton is invariant while gain locations move with the model-task pair, which delimits where compiled harnesses should be deployed.
articles.titleCn: 潜在适配器：将智能体行为编译为块后激活偏移
articles.abstractCn: 利用工程技术和自进化智能体能够快速提升语言模型智能体的性能，但其收益存在于模型外部。每次调用时，该技术都会重新发送并支付，而标准内部化途径是通过权重更新，这一过程迭代成本高且一旦合并即固定。我们提出将此技术编译。潜势技术将外部条件提炼为秩为8的激活偏移。该偏移应用于冻结主干网络的每个解码器块的输出，占参数的0.03-0.05%。条件可以是显式的进程级行为指令，也可以是智能体技术的行为契约。在推理时，编译后的包不包含技术文本，也不增加标记。它提供三种运行时控制，用于注入强度、注入阶段和偏移空间混合。编译后的行为在10个预先注册的设置中的8个中恢复了源技术的收益。在显式源支付最高每调用标记税的情况下，编译形式超过它。相同的包可以在任务间零样本迁移（7对中的5对为正），并在偏移空间中组合，而堆叠的文本指令会破坏性地干扰。作为搜索空间使用时，它们将预算匹配的技术搜索提升了1.45倍。在三个智能体基准测试中，操作员将策略与技术契约对齐。在匹配数据、容量和有效强度下，它优于需要11.1倍参数才能达到相同频段的同等容量LoRA，并且当基础策略已经强大时不会使其退化。在1B至8B模型中，方法框架保持不变，而收益位置随模型-任务对移动，这界定了编译技术应部署的位置。

articles.title: RAG-TRACE: Tracing Measurement Evidence and Diagnostic Completeness in AI-Generated ECG Reports
articles.abstract: Purpose: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can introduce electrocardiogram (ECG) criteria that lack patient-specific measurement support. This study evaluates the reliability of retrieved diagnostic criteria in AI-generated ECG reports. Methods: We analyzed 1,083 human-validated PTB-XL patient records using a library of 47 criteria cards, including 33 without numeric verification rules. Language models generated structured reports with and without retrieval. Criterion applicability was evaluated using Marquette 12SL measurements, with independent assessment using Uni-G and comparison against expert-validated diagnostic labels. Results: Keyword retrieval introduced untestable or measurement-disconfirmed criteria in 46.8% of GPT-4.1-mini reports. A deterministic verification rule withdrew 647 criterion applications, including 639 without numeric checks, while preserving 268 of 269 applications independently supported by Uni-G. Restricting retrieval to 14 testable criteria reduced the initial unsupported-criterion rate to 13.8%. Under matched instructions and an identical output schema, retrieval increased unsupported-criterion reports from 17.4% to 31.1%, while hypertrophy recall remained unchanged at 62.6%. Conclusion: These findings identify a fundamental limitation of retrieval-based clinical report generation: retrieved criteria do not necessarily provide valid patient-specific evidence. Measurement-based verification can reduce unsupported criterion applications, but diagnostic validity requires independent assessment.
articles.comment: Code and study materials available at https://github.com/Elyasirankhah/RAG-TRACE
articles.titleCn: RAG-TRACE：追踪AI生成心电图报告中的测量证据与诊断完整性
articles.abstractCn: 目的：检索增强生成（RAG）可能引入缺乏患者特异性测量支持的电心图（ECG）标准。本研究评估了AI生成的ECG报告中检索到的诊断标准的可靠性。方法：我们使用包含33个无数值验证规则的47张标准卡，分析了1,083份人类验证的PTB-XL患者记录。语言模型在有和无检索的情况下生成结构化报告。使用Marquette 12SL测量评估标准适用性，并使用Uni-G进行独立评估，与专家验证的诊断标签进行比较。结果：关键词检索在46.8%的GPT-4.1-mini报告中引入了无法测试或测量未确认的标准。确定性验证规则撤回了647项标准应用，其中639项无数值检查，同时保留了268项中269项由Uni-G独立支持的应用。将检索限制为14个可测试标准，将初始不支持标准的比率降低至13.8%。在匹配的指令和相同的输出模式下，检索将不支持标准的报告从17.4%增加到31.1%，而肥厚召回率保持在62.6%不变。结论：这些发现确定了基于检索的临床报告生成的一个基本限制：检索到的标准不一定提供有效的患者特异性证据。基于测量的验证可以减少不支持标准的应用，但诊断有效性需要独立评估。

articles.title: Learning by Doing: Autonomously Compiling and Curating Agent Skills from Verified Traces
articles.abstract: Memory systems for production LLM agents mostly store semantic memory (facts about users and domains) or episodic memory (earlier interactions). Research systems such as Trace2Skill, WikiSkill, and SkillRevise learn procedures from agent runs, package them as Skills, and evaluate them on benchmarks. We describe Zep Agent Skills, a production service that gives deployed agents this procedural memory. The service uses only verified attempts as evidence, cites the supporting events for each field of a Skill, and governs the admission and distribution of each Skill version. The service records each task attempt as a Trace with ordered events, an outcome, and a verification strength. A compiler with separate Reflector and Curator roles turns verified Traces into versioned Skills. Scans and admission gates control which candidates become active, and verified use outcomes change the search rank of each Skill. The Agent Skills format is an open standard that Anthropic originated and donated to the Agentic AI Foundation, so any host of the format can load a compiled Skill. Agents retrieve Skills through lexical search with progressive disclosure, over an API or MCP. We evaluate Zep Agent Skills on $τ^3$-bench banking, AppWorld, and EnterpriseOps-Gym. Skills compiled from the Traces of a teacher model increase the pass rate of three weaker executor models on the same tasks, at every reasoning effort, by 4.5 to 18.8 points. Most of the gain is on the tasks that the teacher solved. On ALFWorld, Skills compiled from the runs of a small model give a gain similar to or larger than the gain that prior work reports for continuous fine-tuning, with no training.
articles.titleCn: 边做边学：从验证过的轨迹中自主编译和策展智能体技能
articles.abstractCn: 用于生产大型语言模型代理的内存系统主要存储语义记忆（关于用户和领域的事实）或情景记忆（早期的交互）。Trace2Skill、WikiSkill 和 SkillRevise 等研究系统从代理运行中学习程序，将其打包为技能，并在基准测试上进行评估。我们描述了 Zep Agent Skills，这是一个为已部署代理提供程序记忆的生产服务。该服务仅使用经过验证的尝试作为证据，为技能的每个字段引用支持性事件，并管理每个技能版本的准入和分发。该服务将每个任务尝试记录为带有有序事件、结果和验证强度的跟踪。一个具有独立反思者和策展者角色的编译器将经过验证的跟踪转换为版本化的技能。扫描和准入门控制哪些候选者成为活跃状态，而经过验证的使用结果会改变每个技能的搜索排名。Agent Skills 格式是一个开放标准，由 Anthropic 创建并捐赠给 Agentic AI 基金会，因此任何格式的宿主都可以加载编译后的技能。代理通过 API 或 MCP 进行渐进式披露的词汇搜索来检索技能。我们在 $τ^3$-bench banking、AppWorld 和 EnterpriseOps-Gym 上评估了 Zep Agent Skills。从教师模型的跟踪中编译的技能，在相同任务上的推理努力中，使三个较弱的执行者模型的通过率提高了 4.5 到 18.8 个百分点。大部分提升发生在教师解决的那些任务上。在 ALFWorld 上，从小模型运行中编译的技能带来的提升，与先前工作报告的无训练连续微调带来的提升相似或更大。

articles.title: Information-Theoretic Design of Sparse Autoencoder-Based Steering
articles.abstract: Sparse autoencoder (SAE)-based activation steering is a lightweight approach for modifying the behavior of large language models (LLMs) by adding small vectors to hidden states during inference. However, designing effective steering interventions remains challenging. In this work, we develop an information-theoretic framework for analyzing SAE activations through empirical feature-firing distributions. The central object of the framework is the Jensen--Shannon divergence (JSD) between such firing distributions, which quantifies how far a generated or intervened state deviates from a dataset-induced target distribution. Based on an analytic divergence response for virtually shifted states, we construct steering vectors toward the target firing distribution. The same divergence can also be used to monitor deviation from another empirical distribution, such as a general valid-language distribution. We demonstrate the effectiveness of the steering in a question-mode generation task study. We further use teacher-forced pulse experiments to show that local interventions induce structured downstream JSD responses in later layers, and apply the framework to a safety-related target--contrast response setting for feature analysis.
articles.titleCn: 基于稀疏自编码器的转向的信息论设计
articles.abstractCn: 基于稀疏自动编码器（SAE）的激活引导是一种通过在推理过程中向隐藏状态添加小向量来修改大型语言模型（LLM）行为的轻量级方法。然而，设计有效的引导干预仍然具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们开发了一个信息论框架，通过经验特征点火分布来分析SAE激活。该框架的核心对象是这些点火分布之间的Jensen-Shannon散度（JSD），它量化了生成或干预状态与数据集诱导的目标分布的偏离程度。基于对虚拟偏移状态的解析散度响应，我们构建了指向目标点火分布的引导向量。相同的散度也可以用来监控与另一个经验分布（例如通用有效语言分布）的偏离。我们在问答模式生成任务研究中展示了引导的有效性。我们进一步使用教师强制脉冲实验表明，局部干预在后续层中诱导了结构化的下游JSD响应，并将该框架应用于与安全相关的目标-对比响应设置进行特征分析。

articles.title: XDecideBench: Evaluating Typed Decision Models and Confidence Policies Across Languages
articles.abstract: Applications use Typed Decision Models to route and moderate text in many languages, and they often act only on decisions above a confidence threshold. We introduce XDecideBench, a benchmark of nine suites in 122 languages with 88,425 texts and 153,875 typed questions. All suites share one scoring contract, and we report aligned, locally labelled and native items separately. Model rankings change from suite to suite. The model that is best in English, chosen in hindsight, loses significantly in about a quarter of the suite-language cells, and on Burmese Belebele it falls far behind the best model. Three open models fine-tuned for typed decisions beat the Qwen models they were built from in all twelve development languages. When the Qwen models are run locally, a pre-registered held-out cohort confirms that the accuracy gain is larger in the four languages with the least web text than in the six with the most. In both sets of languages, however, fine-tuning fixes a similar share of the base model's errors, so the larger gain may reflect weaker base models. A confidence threshold set on English data to allow 5% errors exceeds that error rate on XNLI, even in German and French.
articles.titleCn: XDecideBench：跨语言评估类型化决策模型和置信度策略
articles.abstractCn: 应用程序使用类型化决策模型来路由和审核多种语言的文本，并且它们通常只对高于置信度阈值的决策采取行动。我们介绍了XDecideBench，这是一个包含122种语言、88,425篇文本和153,875个类型化问题的九套基准测试。所有套件共享一个评分合约，我们分别报告了对齐的、本地标记的和母语项目。模型排名在不同套件之间有所变化。在回顾中选出的英语最佳模型，在约四分之一的套件语言单元格中显著失分，并且在缅甸贝莱贝莱语中远落后于最佳模型。三个为类型化决策微调的开源模型在所有十二种开发语言中都超越了它们所基于的Qwen模型。当Qwen模型在本地运行时，预先注册的保留队列证实，在拥有最少网络文本的四种语言中获得的准确率提升比在拥有最多网络文本的六种语言中大。然而，在这两组语言中，微调都修正了基础模型相当比例的错误，因此更大的提升可能反映了较弱的基础模型。在英语数据上设置的置信度阈值允许5%的错误率，即使在德语和法语中，该错误率也超过了XNLI的错误率。
